title.zh: 卷八 本紀第八 真宗三
title.raw: 卷八 本紀第八 真宗三 Volume 8 Annals 8: Zhenzong 3

sentences.zh: 四年春正月辛巳，詔執事汾陰懈怠者，罪勿原。

translations.literal: Year four, spring, first month, day xinsi, edict: those in charge of Fenyin who were negligent—their crimes were not to be pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Spring, first month, xinsi of year four: officials who had slackened Fenyin duties were told their offenses would not be forgiven.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，習祀後土儀。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: the rite of sacrificing to Earth was rehearsed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, the court rehearsed the Earth altar rites.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，將祀汾陰，謁啟聖院太宗神禦殿、普安院元德皇后聖容。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: about to sacrifice at Fenyin, the emperor visited Taizong’s spirit hall at Qisheng Court and the Bright Virtue empress’s image at Pu’an Court.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, before Fenyin, he bowed at Qisheng’s Taizong shrine and Pu’an’s Bright Virtue portrait.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔以六月六日天書再降日為天貺節。

translations.literal: Day bingshen, edict: the day the Heavenly Book descended again, the sixth of the sixth month, was made the Heavenly Gift festival.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the sixth day of the sixth month—when the Heavenly Book had descended again—was declared the Heavenly Gift festival.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，奉天書發京師。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the Heavenly Book was escorted out of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the Heavenly Book procession left the capital.

sentences.zh: 日上有黃氣如匹素，五色雲如蓋，紫氣翼仗。

translations.literal: On the sun appeared yellow vapor like a bolt of silk, five-colored clouds like a canopy, and purple mist flanking the imperial train.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow mist veiled the sun like raw silk; five-colored clouds arched overhead and purple vapor flanked the carriage.

sentences.zh: 庚子，右僕射、判河陽張齊賢見於汜水頓。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Right Vice Director Zhang Qixian, acting at Heyang, was received at the Sishui halt.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Heyang’s vice director Zhang Qixian was received at the Sishui stop.

sentences.zh: 陳堯叟獻白鹿。

translations.literal: Chen Yaosou presented a white deer.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yaosou offered a white deer.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，陳幄殿於訾村，望拜諸陵。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: a tent hall was set up at Zi village and the imperial tombs were saluted from afar.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, a field pavilion at Zi village faced the distant tombs in obeisance.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，至慈澗頓，賜道傍耕民茶荈。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: the halt at Cijian was reached; tea was bestowed on farmers along the road.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, at Cijian, roadside plowmen received tea.

sentences.zh: 二月戊申，賜扈駕諸軍緡錢。

translations.literal: Second month, day wushen: silk cash was bestowed on all armies in the imperial escort.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, wushen: escort troops received cash gifts.

sentences.zh: 華州獻芝草。

translations.literal: Hua prefecture presented auspicious fungus.
translations.idiomatic: Huazhou reported spirit fungus.

sentences.zh: 東京獄空。

translations.literal: The eastern capital’s prisons were empty.
translations.idiomatic: Luoyang’s jails stood empty.

sentences.zh: 壬子，出潼關，渡渭河，遣近臣祠西嶽。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Tong Pass was exited, the Wei River crossed, and close officials were sent to sacrifice at the western peak.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the court passed Tong Pass, forded the Wei, and dispatched intimates to rite the western sacred peak.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，次河中府。

translations.literal: Day guichou: the halt at Hezhong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the procession rested at Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，黃雲隨天書輦。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: yellow clouds followed the Heavenly Book carriage.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, yellow clouds trailed the Heavenly Book train.

sentences.zh: 次寶鼎縣奉祗宮。

translations.literal: The halt at Baoding county’s Offering Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The court lodged at Baoding’s Offering Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊午，登後圃延慶亭。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: the rear garden’s Yanqing pavilion was ascended.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, he climbed Yanqing pavilion in the rear garden.

sentences.zh: 己未，瀵泉湧，有光如燭。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the Fen spring gushed forth, with light like candles.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the Fen spring burst forth glowing like torches.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，祀後土地祗。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Earth the terrestrial spirit was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, he offered to Earth.

sentences.zh: 是夜，月重輪，還奉祗宮，紫氣四塞。

translations.literal: That night the moon showed double halos; returning to the Offering Palace, purple vapor filled the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: That night a double halo ringed the moon; back at the Offering Palace, purple mist closed in on every side.

sentences.zh: 幸開元寺，作大寧宮。

translations.literal: Kaiyuan Monastery was visited and the Daning palace was built.
translations.idiomatic: He visited Kaiyuan Monastery and raised Daning Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，甘州回鶻、蒲端、三麻蘭、勿巡、蒲婆、大食國、吐蕃諸族來貢。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Ganzhou Uighurs, Pu’anduan, Sanmalan, Wuxun, Pupo, Dashi, and Tibetan tribes came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, tribute arrived from Ganzhou Uighurs, Pu’anduan, Sanmalan, Wuxun, Pupo, Arabs, and Tibetan peoples.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，常赦不原者鹹赦除之。

translations.literal: Great amnesty for the empire; even those the regular amnesty did not spare were all remitted.
translations.idiomatic: A universal pardon even cleared crimes the routine amnesty had left standing.

sentences.zh: 文武官並遷秩，該敘封欲回授祖父母者聽。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were all advanced in rank; those wishing to redirect enfeoffment to grandparents were permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military ranks rose across the board; honors could be shifted to grandparents if desired.

sentences.zh: 四品以上，迨事太祖、太宗潛藩或嘗更邊任家無食祿者，錄其子孫。

translations.literal: From the fourth rank up, those who had served the hidden estates of Taizu and Taizong or once held frontier posts yet whose families held no stipend— their descendants were enrolled.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of fourth rank and above who had served the princely households of Taizu and Taizong or frontier commands without stipends for their heirs—those heirs were now registered.

sentences.zh: 建寶鼎縣為慶成軍。

translations.literal: Baoding county was made Qingcheng army.
translations.idiomatic: Baoding county became Qingcheng army.

sentences.zh: 建隆佐命及公王將相丘塚，所在致祭。

translations.literal: The tombs of Jianlong’s founding aides and of dukes, kings, generals, and ministers were to receive sacrifices wherever located.
translations.idiomatic: Founding aides and the tombs of nobles and generals were to be honored with sacrifices in every locality.

sentences.zh: 給西京分司官實奉三分之一。

translations.literal: Western capital branch officials were given a third of their full salary in kind.
translations.idiomatic: Luoyang branch officials received one-third of full salary in goods.

sentences.zh: 令法官慎刑名，有情輕法重者以聞。

translations.literal: Judges were ordered to be careful with penal names; where affection warranted a lighter law but a heavier one applied, it was to be reported.
translations.idiomatic: Judges were warned to weigh sentences carefully and report cases where mercy argued against the statute.

sentences.zh: 賜天下酺三日。

translations.literal: The empire was given three days of public feasting.
translations.idiomatic: Three days of empire-wide revelry were proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 大宴群臣于穆清殿，賜父老酒食衣幣。

translations.literal: A great feast for the ministers was held in Muqing Hall; elders received wine, food, and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Muqing Hall hosted a grand feast; local elders received wine, food, and silk.

sentences.zh: 作《汾陰配饗銘》、《河瀆四海贊》。

translations.literal: The “Fenyin Accompanying Sacrifice Inscription” and “Ode to the Yellow River and the Four Seas” were composed.
translations.idiomatic: He composed the Fenyin sacrifice inscription and odes to the Yellow River and four seas.

sentences.zh: 召草澤李瀆、劉巽，瀆以疾辭，授巽大理評事。

translations.literal: Recluses Li Du and Liu Xun were summoned; Du declined on grounds of illness; Xun was made an evaluator of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: Hermits Li Du and Liu Xun were called; Du pleaded illness; Xun received a judicial review post.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，觀酺。

translations.literal: Day yichou: public feasting was viewed.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, he watched the public revels.

sentences.zh: 加號西嶽。

translations.literal: The western peak received an augmented title.
translations.idiomatic: The western sacred peak gained an exalted title.

sentences.zh: 詔葺夷齊祠。

translations.literal: An edict ordered repair of the shrines to Bo Yi and Shu Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Shrines to Bo Yi and Shu Qi were ordered restored.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，賜甯王元偓服帶、鞍馬有加。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Prince of Ning Yuanwei was given added belts, robes, saddles, and horses.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Prince of Ning Yuanwei received extra harness and mounts.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，次華州，幸雲台觀。

translations.literal: Day yisi: the halt at Hua prefecture; Yuntai Abbey was visited.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, at Huazhou, he visited Yuntai Abbey.

sentences.zh: 庚午，宴宣澤亭，紫雲如龍，起嶽上。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: a feast at Xuanze pavilion; purple clouds like dragons rose from the peak.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, at Xuanze pavilion, purple dragon-like clouds lifted from the mountain.

sentences.zh: 召見隱士鄭隱、李寧，賜茶果、束帛。

translations.literal: Recluses Zheng Yin and Li Ning were summoned and given tea, fruit, and silk.
translations.idiomatic: Hermits Zheng Yin and Li Ning were received and given tea, fruit, and cloth.

sentences.zh: 辛未，次閿鄉縣，召見道士柴又玄，問以無為之要。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: the halt at Min township; Daoist Chai Youxuan was summoned and questioned on the essentials of non-action.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, at Min township, Daoist Chai Youxuan was asked about the way of non-action.

sentences.zh: 壬申，宴虢州父老於湖城行宮。

translations.literal: Day renshen: elders of Guo prefecture were feasted at the Hucheng traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Guo elders were banqueted at the Hucheng palace.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌，次陝州，召草澤魏野，辭疾不至。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiaxu: the halt at Shan prefecture; recluse Wei Ye was summoned but declined on grounds of illness and did not come.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiaxu: at Shanzhou, recluse Wei Ye was summoned but stayed home, pleading illness.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，賜運船卒時服。

translations.literal: Day yihai: seasonal garments were bestowed on transport-boat crews.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, grain-barge crews received seasonal clothes.

sentences.zh: 己卯，次西京。

translations.literal: Day jimao: the halt at the western capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the court reached Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，罷河北緣邊工役。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: corvée labor on the Hebei frontier was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Hebei labor drafts were stopped.

sentences.zh: 壬午，幸上清宮。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Shangqing Palace was visited.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, he went to Shangqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲申，幸崇法院，移幸呂蒙正第，賜服禦、金幣。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Chongfa Court was visited, then Lü Mengzheng’s residence; imperial robes and gold were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, he called at Chongfa Court, then Lü Mengzheng’s house, gifting court dress and gold.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，大宴大明殿。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: a great feast in Daming Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, a grand banquet filled Daming Hall.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔葺所經歷代帝王祠廟。

translations.literal: Day dinghai, edict: temples of emperors through the ages along the route were to be repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, shrines to past emperors on the route were ordered restored.

sentences.zh: 己丑，禦五鳳樓觀酺。

translations.literal: Day jichou: from Wufeng Tower the public feasting was viewed.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, he watched the revels from Wufeng Tower.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔朝陵自西京至鞏縣不舉樂。

translations.literal: Day renchen, edict: from the western capital to Gong county while visiting the tombs, music was not to be played.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, tomb processions from Luoyang to Gong county were to proceed in silence.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，禁扈從人踐田稼。

translations.literal: Day guisi: escorts were forbidden to trample fields.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the escort was forbidden to tread crops.

sentences.zh: 甲午，發西京。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: departure from the western capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the court left Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 丙申，謁安陵、永昌諸陵。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Anling, Yongchang, and other tombs were visited.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Anling, Yongchang, and the other tombs were visited.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，幸列子廟，表潘孝子墓。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Liezi’s temple was visited; the filial son Pan’s tomb was marked with a stele.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, he visited Liezi’s shrine and marked the filial Pan’s grave.

sentences.zh: 五月丙子，加交阯郡王李公蘊同平章事。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingzi: Jiaozhi Prince Li Gongyun was made co-grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, bingzi: Jiaozhi’s Li Gongyun received a council seat.

sentences.zh: 癸未，廬、宿、泗等州麥自生。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Lu, Su, and Si prefectures reported wheat growing of itself.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Lu, Su, and Si reported self-sown wheat.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，幸北宅視德存疾。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the Northern Residence was visited to see Dechun’s illness.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, he called on the sick Dechun at the Northern Residence.

sentences.zh: 京兆旱，詔振之。

translations.literal: Jingzhao suffered drought; an edict ordered relief.
translations.idiomatic: Drought in the capital region brought relief orders.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔州城置孔子廟。

translations.literal: Day guisi, edict: Confucian temples were to be placed in prefectural cities.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, every prefectural seat was to have a Confucian temple.

sentences.zh: 乙未，加上五嶽帝號，作《奉神述》。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: augmented titles were given the five sacred peak emperors; “Account of Serving the Spirits” was composed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the five peaks received new divine titles and he wrote Serving the Spirits.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，慮囚，死罪流徒降等，杖以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: prisoners were reviewed; capital, exile, and penal servitude were reduced one degree; those below the rod were released.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, a prison review cut capital and exile one grade and freed those due only flogging.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，視德存疾。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Dechun’s illness was visited.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, he again visited Dechun.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingwu: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, bingwu: Venus shone in daylight.

sentences.zh: 亳州二龍見禹祠。

translations.literal: Two dragons appeared at Yu’s shrine in Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Bozhou reported two dragons at Yu’s shrine.

sentences.zh: 德存卒。

translations.literal: Dechun died.
translations.idiomatic: Dechun died.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，遣使安撫江、淮南水災，許便宜從事。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: envoys were sent to comfort Jiang and Huainan flood victims, empowered to act as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, envoys went to Jiang-Huai flood zones with discretionary powers to aid victims.

sentences.zh: 詔授交、甘等州、大食、蒲端、三麻蘭、勿巡國奉使官。

translations.literal: Edict: envoy posts were conferred on tribute missions from Jiaozhou, Ganzhou, Dashi, Pu’anduan, Sanmalan, and Wuxun.
translations.idiomatic: Envoy ranks were granted to embassies from Jiaozhou, Ganzhou, the Arabs, Pu’anduan, Sanmalan, and Wuxun.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申朔，除閩、浙、荊湖、廣南歲丁錢四十五萬。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renshen new moon: the annual head-tax of 450,000 on Min, Zhe, Jinghu, and Guangnan was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, new moon renshen: the 450,000-head poll tax on the southeast circuits was abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬午，韓國、吳國、隋國長公主進封衛國、楚國、越國長公主。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Princesses of Han, Wu, and Sui were advanced to Princesses of Wei, Chu, and Yue.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the Han, Wu, and Sui princesses became Princesses of Wei, Chu, and Yue.

sentences.zh: 鎮、眉、昌等州地震。

translations.literal: Zhen, Mei, and Chang prefectures were shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen, Mei, and Chang quaked.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔先蠲濱、棣州水災田租十之三，今所輸七分更除其半。

translations.literal: Day jichou, edict: Bin and Di flood lands had already had a third of rent remitted; of the seven parts now due, half of that was again remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Bin-Di flood fields already cut one-third in rent saw half of the remainder forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丙申，江、洪、筠、袁江漲，沒民田。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Jiang, Hong, Yun, and Yuan rivers rose and drowned people’s fields.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Jiang, Hong, Yun, and Yuan floods drowned farmland.

sentences.zh: 八月乙巳，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yisi: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, yisi: Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 丙午，幸南宮視惟敘疾。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: the Southern Palace was visited to see Weixu’s illness.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, he visited the ailing Weixu in the Southern Palace.

sentences.zh: 詔除纁田租。

translations.literal: An edict remitted crimson-field rent.
translations.idiomatic: Crimson-field land tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，曲宴諸王、宰相。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: an informal feast was held for the princes and grand councilors.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, princes and councilors shared a private banquet.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，賜青州孤老煢獨民帛。

translations.literal: Day guichou: cloth was bestowed on Qingzhou’s solitary aged and widowed.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Qingzhou’s destitute elderly received cloth.

sentences.zh: 惟敘卒。

translations.literal: Weixu died.
translations.idiomatic: Weixu died.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，錄唐長孫無忌、段秀實等孫，授官。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: descendants of Tang’s Zhangsun Wuji, Duan Xiushi, and others were enrolled and given office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, heirs of Zhangsun Wuji, Duan Xiushi, and other Tang worthies received posts.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔文武官有言刑政得失、邊防機事者並賜對。

translations.literal: Day dingsi, edict: civil and military officials with views on penal policy, frontier affairs, or military intelligence were all granted audience.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, any official with counsel on law, borders, or defense was promised a hearing.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，甘州回紇可汗夜落紇奉表詣闕。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Ganzhou Uighur khan Yeluohuo presented a memorial at court.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Ganzhou’s Uighur khan Yeluohuo appeared at court.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，刻禦制《大中祥符頌》于左承天祥符門。

translations.literal: Day yichou: the imperial composition “Ode of Great Central Auspice” was carved at the left Gate of Heavenly Blessing.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, his Great Central Auspice ode was carved at the left Gate of Heavenly Blessing.

sentences.zh: 河決通利軍，合御河，壞州城及傷田廬，遣使發粟振之。

translations.literal: The Yellow River burst its banks at Tongli army, joined the imperial canal, ruined the prefectural city and damaged fields and houses; envoys were sent with grain to relieve.
translations.idiomatic: Floods at Tongli army broke into the imperial canal, wrecked the city and farms; grain relief followed.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，涇原鈐轄曹瑋言籠竿川熟戶蕃部以閒田輸官，請於要害地募兵以居，從之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingchou: Jingyuan controller Cao Wei reported that mature Fan households of Longgou Creek offered idle land to the state and asked to recruit troops for garrison at strategic points; assent.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, dingchou: Cao Wei reported Longgou Fan clans offering idle land for frontier garrisons; the throne agreed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，幸太乙宮祈晴。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Taiyi Palace was visited to pray for clear weather.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, he prayed for sun at Taiyi Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，向敏中等為五嶽奉冊使。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Xiang Minzhong and others were made envoys bearing registers to the five peaks.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Xiang Minzhong and others became five-peak register envoys.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，禦乾元樓觀酺。

translations.literal: Day guisi: from Qianyuan Tower the public feasting was viewed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, he watched revels from Qianyuan Tower.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申，禦朝元殿發五嶽冊。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wushen: from Chaoyuan Hall the five-peak registers were dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, wushen: five-peak registers were issued from Chaoyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，定江、淮鹽酒價，有司慮失歲課，帝曰：「苟便於民，何顧歲入也。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Jiang-Huai salt and wine prices were fixed; the departments feared lost revenue; the emperor said: “If it benefits the people, why worry about yearly intake?”
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Jiang-Huai salt and wine prices were capped; when clerks feared lost revenue, he said, “If the people gain, why count the intake?”

sentences.zh: 」十一月庚午，占城國貢獅子。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengwu: Champa presented a lion.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, gengwu: Champa sent a lion.

sentences.zh: 丙子，禦試服勤詞學、經明行修貢舉人。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the imperial examination for assiduous literary learning and classics with conduct was held.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the court tested candidates in classics and moral conduct.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳，詔楚、泰州潮害稼，復租。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yisi, edict: Chu and Tai prefectures’ tidal damage to crops—rent was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, yisi: tidal damage at Chu and Tai won rent relief.

sentences.zh: 沒溺人賜千錢、粟一斛。

translations.literal: Those drowned were given a thousand cash and one hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Drowning victims’ families received cash and grain.

sentences.zh: 是歲，西涼府、夏、豐、交州、甘州、諸溪峒蠻來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Xiliang prefecture, Xia, Feng, Jiaozhou, Ganzhou, and various creek-dong tribes came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute came from Xiliang, Xia, Feng, Jiaozhou, Ganzhou, and creek-dong chiefs.

sentences.zh: 畿內蝗。

translations.literal: Locusts within the capital circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts plagued the capital region.

sentences.zh: 河北、陝西、劍南饑。

translations.literal: Hebei, Shaanxi, and Sword South suffered famine.
translations.idiomatic: Famine struck Hebei, Shaanxi, and the southwest.

sentences.zh: 吉州、臨江軍江水溢，害民田舍。

translations.literal: Jizhou and Linjiang army: the Yangzi overflowed and damaged people’s fields and houses.
translations.idiomatic: At Jizhou and Linjiang, Yangzi floods ruined fields and homes.

sentences.zh: 兗州虸蚄蟲，不為災。

translations.literal: Yanzhou had inchworm pests; they did no harm.
translations.idiomatic: Inchworms plagued Yanzhou but caused no crop damage.

sentences.zh: 五年正月乙亥，賜處州進士周啟明粟帛。

translations.literal: Fifth year, first month, day yihai: grain and silks were bestowed on Zhou Qiming of Chuzhou, a presented scholar.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the first month of the fifth year, Chuzhou graduate Zhou Qiming received grain and cloth.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，雨木冰。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: glazed frost fell on trees.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, trees were coated in glazed ice.

sentences.zh: 壬午，幸元偁宮視疾。

translations.literal: Day renwu: he visited Prince Yuan Cheng’s palace to inquire after an illness.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he called at Prince Yuan Cheng’s residence to see the sick.

sentences.zh: 河決棣州。

translations.literal: The Yellow River burst its banks at Di prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Floods broke the Yellow River levees at Dizhou.

sentences.zh: 二月庚戌，詔貢舉人公罪聽贖。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengxu, edict: presented scholars guilty of public offenses were permitted to redeem punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, gengxu: graduates who committed public crimes could buy off their penalties.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔官吏安撫濱、棣被水農民。

translations.literal: Day bingyin, edict: officials were to comfort farmers in Bin and Di stricken by flood.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin officials were ordered to aid flood-stricken farmers in Bin and Di.

sentences.zh: 三月己丑，禦試禮部舉人。

translations.literal: Third month, day jichou: the emperor held the palace examination of Ministry of Rites graduates.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jichou: the court examined Ministry of Rites graduates in the palace.

sentences.zh: 丁未，峒酋田仕瓊等貢溪布。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: cave chieftain Tian Shiqiong and others presented stream cloth as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, chieftain Tian Shiqiong and fellow cave lords sent stream cloth tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，王旦等並加特進、功臣。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Wang Dan and others were all given the special advancement and merit subjects.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Wang Dan and colleagues were promoted to special advancement with merit titles.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，免濱、棣民物入城市者稅一年。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: for one year the tax on goods Bin and Di people brought into cities was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Bin and Di were freed for a year from market-entry taxes on goods.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申，以向敏中為平章事。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wushen: Xiang Minzhong was made Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, wushen: Xiang Minzhong joined the grand council.

sentences.zh: 有司請違法販茶者許同居首告，帝謂以利敗俗非國體，不許。

translations.literal: The offices asked that illegal tea traffickers be allowed household co-residents to inform first; the emperor said that using profit to ruin custom was not the state’s form and did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: When officials proposed letting neighbors inform on illegal tea dealers, the emperor refused, saying profit-driven denunciation was not fit for the realm.

sentences.zh: 壬子，除通、泰、楚州鹽亭戶積負丁額課鹽。

translations.literal: Day renzi: the accumulated salt-tax quotas owed by salt-pavilion households of Tong, Tai, and Chu prefectures were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, long-overdue salt quotas for Tong, Tai, and Chu salt-pavilion households were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，樞密直學士邊肅責授岳州團練副使。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Privy Council academician Bian Su was demoted and appointed Yuezhou army training vice-commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Privy Council academician Bian Su was cashiered to Yuezhou training vice-commissioner.

sentences.zh: 五月辛未，江、淮、兩浙旱，給占城稻種，教民種之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinwei: Jianghuai and the two Zhe circuits suffered drought; Champa rice seed was given out and the people taught to plant it.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, xinwei: drought in Jianghuai and the two Zhes brought Champa rice seed and planting instruction.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，修儀劉氏進封德妃。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Lady of Cultivated Deportment Liu was advanced to Virtuous Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Cultivated Deportment Liu became Virtuous Consort.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，免棣州租十之三。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: a third of Di prefecture’s land tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Dizhou’s land tax was cut by a third.

sentences.zh: 戊子，賜近臣金華殿所種麥。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: close ministers were given wheat grown at the Jinhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, the emperor shared Jinhua Hall wheat with his inner circle.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申，賜杭州草澤林逋粟帛。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengshen: grain and silks were bestowed on the Hangzhou recluse Lin Bu.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, gengshen: the Hangzhou hermit Lin Bu received grain and silks.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔常參官舉幕職、州縣官充京官。

translations.literal: Day renxu, edict: regular-attendance officials were to recommend bureau staff and prefectural and county officials for capital posts.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, regular-attendance officers were told to nominate local and bureau men for capital office.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，賜邵武軍被水者錢粟。

translations.literal: Day guihai: money and grain were given to those flooded in Shaowu Army.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Shaowu flood victims received cash and grain.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰，作保康門。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuchen: Baokang Gate was built.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, wuchen: Baokang Gate was erected.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingshen new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, new moon bingshen: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，禁周太祖葬冠劍地樵采。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: cutting firewood was forbidden in the crown-and-sword burial ground of Zhou Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, woodcutting was banned at Taizu’s crown-and-sword tomb precinct.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，張齊賢為司空致仕。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Zhang Qixian was made Minister of Works and retired.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Zhang Qixian retired as Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔樞密直學士限置六員。

translations.literal: Day jiachen, edict: Privy Council academicians were limited to six posts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Privy Council academician posts were capped at six.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，淮南旱，減運河水灌民田，仍寬租限，州縣不能存恤致民流亡者罪之。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Huainan suffered drought; canal water was reduced to irrigate the people’s fields and rent deadlines were eased; prefectures and counties that failed to preserve and comfort the people, causing them to flee, were to be punished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Huainan drought brought reduced canal diversions, rent extensions, and penalties for officials whose neglect drove people away.

sentences.zh: 己未，作五嶽觀。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the Five Sacred Peaks Abbey was built.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the Five Sacred Peaks Abbey was founded.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，張齊賢入對。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinwei: Zhang Qixian was received in audience.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, xinwei: Zhang Qixian faced the throne.

sentences.zh: 壬申，觀新作延安橋。

translations.literal: Day renshen: the newly built Yan’an Bridge was inspected.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the court viewed the new Yan’an Bridge.

sentences.zh: 幸大相國寺、上清宮。

translations.literal: He visited the Great Xiangguo Temple and the Supreme Purity Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He called at Great Xiangguo Temple and Supreme Purity Palace.

sentences.zh: 射于宜春苑。

translations.literal: He shot arrows at the Yichun Garden.
translations.idiomatic: He shot at Yichun Garden.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，徙澄海三指揮屯嶺北州郡。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the three Chenghai commands were moved to garrison northern Ling circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, three Chenghai commands were posted to northern Ling prefectures.

sentences.zh: 戊子，王欽若、陳堯叟並為樞密使、同平章事，丁謂為戶部侍郎、參知政事。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Wang Qinruo and Chen Yaozi were both made Privy Council commissioners and co-grand councilors; Ding Wei was made Vice Minister of Revenue and Participation Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Wang Qinruo and Chen Yaozi became privy commissioners and co-councilors; Ding Wei joined the council as revenue vice minister.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，幸故鄆王、兗王宮。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: he visited the former palaces of the Yun prince and the Yan prince.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, he toured the old Yun and Yan princely residences.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午，延恩殿道場，帝瞻九天司命天尊降。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuwu: at the Yan’en Hall ritual ground the emperor beheld the descent of the Nine Heavens Director of Fates Celestial Worthy.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, wuwu: at Yan’en Hall’s ritual ground the emperor saw the Nine Heavens Director of Fates descend.

sentences.zh: 己未，大赦天下，賜致仕官全奉。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: a great amnesty was proclaimed; retired officials were given full stipends.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the realm was amnestied and retirees granted full salaries.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，作《崇儒術論》，刻石國學。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: he composed “On Honoring Confucian Learning” and had it carved on stone at the National University.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, his essay “On Honoring Confucian Learning” was engraved at the National University.

sentences.zh: 閏月己巳，上聖祖尊號。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day jisi: the Sagely Ancestor’s honorific title was elevated.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, jisi: the Sagely Ancestor received a higher honorific.

sentences.zh: 辛未，謝太廟。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: thanks were offered at the Imperial Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the court gave thanks at the Imperial Temple.

sentences.zh: 壬申，立先天、降聖節，五日休沐、輟刑。

translations.literal: Day renshen: the Prior Heaven and Descent of Sageliness festivals were established—five days’ rest and a halt to punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Prior Heaven and Descent of Sageliness became holidays with five days’ rest and suspended punishments.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔上聖祖母懿號，加太廟六室尊諡。

translations.literal: Day yihai, edict: the Sagely Ancestor’s grandmother received a honorific title; the six Imperial Temple chambers received augmented posthumous titles.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the Sagely Ancestor’s grandmother was titled and six ancestral chambers received new posthumous names.

sentences.zh: 丙子，群臣上尊號曰崇文廣武感天尊道應真佑德上聖欽明仁孝皇帝。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the ministers elevated his honorific to Sagely Emperor of Honoring Culture, Expanding Martial Power, Responding to Heaven’s Worthy Way, True Blessing and Virtue, Sagely Illumination and Humane Filial Piety.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, ministers offered the long honorific Sagely Emperor of culture, martial glory, heavenly response, true blessing, illumination, and filial piety.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，出舒州所獲瑞石，文曰「志公記」。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: the auspicious stone taken at Shuzhou was displayed; its inscription read “Record of Master Zhi.”
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Shuzhou’s “auspicious stone” bearing “Record of Master Zhi” was shown at court.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，建景靈宮太極觀于壽丘。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: the Supreme Purity Abbey of the Splendid Spirit Palace was built at Shou Hill.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Splendid Spirit Palace’s Supreme Purity Abbey rose at Shou Hill.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，建安軍鑄聖像。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Jian’an Army cast the sacred image.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Jian’an Army cast the sacred image.

sentences.zh: 龍見雲中。

translations.literal: A dragon appeared in the clouds.
translations.idiomatic: A dragon was seen in the clouds.

sentences.zh: 戊子，禦制配享樂章並二舞名，文曰《發祥流慶》，武曰《降真觀德》。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: he composed the accompanying sacrifice music and the names of the two dances—the civil called “Sending Blessings and Flowing Celebration,” the martial “Descending Truth and Observing Virtue.”
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, he set sacrifice music and dance titles—“Sending Blessings” for the civil dance and “Descending Truth” for the martial.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙申，親祀玉皇於朝元殿。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingshen: he personally sacrificed to the Jade Emperor at Chaoyuan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, bingshen: he personally offered to the Jade Emperor at Chaoyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，加王旦門下侍郎，向敏中中書侍郎，楚王元佐太師，相王元偓太傅，舒王元偁太保。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Wang Dan was made Vice Director of the Secretariat; Xiang Minzhong Director of the Secretariat; Prince of Chu Yuan Zuo Grand Preceptor; Prince of Xiang Yuan Wei Grand Tutor; Prince of Shu Yuan Cheng Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Wang Dan became Secretariat vice director, Xiang Minzhong director, and the Chu, Xiang, and Shu princes received grand tutor ranks.

sentences.zh: 內外官加恩。

translations.literal: Inner and outer officials received added favor.
translations.idiomatic: Officials inside and outside the capital were showered with favors.

sentences.zh: 置玉清昭應宮使。

translations.literal: The Jade Pure Manifest Response Palace commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: A commissioner for the Jade Pure Manifest Response Palace was created.

sentences.zh: 以王旦為之。

translations.literal: Wang Dan was appointed to it.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Dan took the post.

sentences.zh: 丁未，作《汴水發願文》。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: he composed “Vow Text on the Bian River.”
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, he wrote the “Vow Text on the Bian River.”

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔允言朝參。

translations.literal: Day gengxu, edict: Yanyan was permitted court attendance.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Yanyan was allowed to attend court.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，罷獻珍禽異獸。

translations.literal: Day yimao: presentation of rare birds and beasts was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, tribute of exotic birds and beasts was ended.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，置景福殿使。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiazi: the Splendid Blessing Hall commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiazi: a Splendid Blessing Hall commissioner was instituted.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，作景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: the Splendid Spirit Palace was built.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Splendid Spirit Palace was erected.

sentences.zh: 京師大寒，鬻官炭四十萬，減市直之半以濟貧民。

translations.literal: The capital was bitterly cold; four hundred thousand units of official charcoal were sold, half the market price, to aid the poor.
translations.idiomatic: In bitter capital cold, four hundred thousand loads of official charcoal were sold at half price for the poor.

sentences.zh: 壬申，改諡玄聖文宣王曰至聖文宣王。

translations.literal: Day renshen: the posthumous title of the Sagely Culture King of Profound Sanctity was changed to Sagely Culture King of Utmost Sanctity.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Confucius’ posthumous title was raised from “Profound” to “Utmost” Sagely Culture King.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，溪峒張文喬等八百人來朝。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: eight hundred men of Stream Caves led by Zhang Wenqiao came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Zhang Wenqiao and eight hundred stream-cave men presented themselves at court.

sentences.zh: 己卯，知天雄軍寇准言獄空，詔獎之。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Tianxiong military commissioner Kou Zhun reported empty prisons; an edict praised him.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Kou Zhun of Tianxiong reported empty jails and received imperial praise.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，振泗州饑。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Sizhou famine was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, famine relief reached Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔天慶等節日，民犯罪情輕者釋之。

translations.literal: Day bingxu, edict: on Heavenly Celebration and similar festivals, commoners guilty of light offenses were released.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, light crimes by commoners were forgiven on Heavenly Celebration and like holidays.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，立德妃劉氏為皇后。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Virtuous Consort Liu was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Virtuous Consort Liu became empress.

sentences.zh: 是歲，交州、甘州、西涼府、溪峒蠻來貢。

translations.literal: That year Jiaozhou, Ganzhou, Xiliang prefecture, and stream-cave barbarians came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Jiaozhou, Ganzhou, Xiliang, and stream-cave peoples sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 京城、河北、淮南饑，減直鬻穀以濟流民。

translations.literal: The capital, Hebei, and Huainan suffered famine; grain was sold below market price to aid refugees.
translations.idiomatic: Famine in the capital, Hebei, and Huainan brought subsidized grain sales for refugees.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月癸巳朔，上御朝元殿受朝。

translations.literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, day guisi new moon: the emperor received court at Chaoyuan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: First month, new moon guisi: he held court at Chaoyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 司天監言五星同色。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Astronomy reported the five planets of one color.
translations.idiomatic: Astronomers reported the five planets sharing one hue.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔減配隸法十二條。

translations.literal: Day gengzi, edict: twelve articles of the penal servitude code were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, twelve clauses of the penal servitude code were lightened.

sentences.zh: 戊申，禁內臣出使預民政。

translations.literal: Day wushen, edict: inner attendants on missions were forbidden to interfere in civil government.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, palace eunuchs on mission were barred from civil administration.

sentences.zh: 己酉，賜京師酺五日。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: the capital was granted five days of communal feasting.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, the capital received five days of public feasting.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，進封衛國、楚國、越國長公主三人為徐國、邠國、宿國。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the three elder princesses of Wei, Chu, and Yue were advanced to princesses of Xu, Bin, and Su.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the Wei, Chu, and Yue elder princesses became princesses of Xu, Bin, and Su.

sentences.zh: 庚申，置淑儀、淑容、順儀、順容、婉儀、婉容，在昭儀上。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Fair Conduct, Fair Countenance, Complaisant Conduct, Complaisant Countenance, Gentle Conduct, and Gentle Countenance were established above Bright Conduct.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, six new consort ranks were placed above Bright Conduct.

sentences.zh: 置司宮令，在尚宮上。

translations.literal: The Director of Palace Affairs was established above the Director of the Inner Palace.
translations.idiomatic: A Director of Palace Affairs was created senior to the Inner Palace director.

sentences.zh: 以婕妤楊氏為婉儀，貴人戴氏為修儀，美人曹氏為婕妤。

translations.literal: Lady Yang of Talented Fairness was made Gentle Conduct; Lady Dai of Honored Fairness Cultivated Conduct; Lady Cao of Beautiful Lady Talented Fairness.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Yang became Gentle Conduct, Lady Dai Cultivated Conduct, and Lady Cao Talented Fairness.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔宗正寺以帝籍為玉牒。

translations.literal: Day xinyou, edict: the Directorate of the Imperial Clan was to treat the imperial genealogy as the jade register.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the clan directorate was ordered to keep the imperial genealogy as the jade register.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰，觀酺。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuchen: communal feasting was observed.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, wuchen: the court watched public feasts.

sentences.zh: 己亥，泰州言海陵草中生聖米，可濟饑。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Taizhou reported sacred rice growing wild at Hailing—able to relieve famine.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Taizhou said sacred rice sprang up at Hailing to feed the hungry.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未，詔沙門島流人罪輕者徙近地。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingwei, edict: exiles on Shamen Island guilty of light offenses were moved nearer.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, dingwei: light offenders on Shamen Island were relocated inland.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，建安軍鑄玉皇、聖祖、太祖、太宗尊像成，以丁謂為迎奉使。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Jian’an Army finished casting the images of the Jade Emperor, Sagely Ancestor, Taizu, and Taizong; Ding Wei was made reception commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Jian’an finished the Jade Emperor and imperial images; Ding Wei was named reception commissioner.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚辰，詔淮南給饑民粥，麥登乃止。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengchen, edict: Huainan was to give congee to the hungry until the wheat harvest.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, gengchen: Huainan fed the hungry porridge until wheat came in.

sentences.zh: 壬午，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Venus shone in daylight.

sentences.zh: 癸未，幸元偁宮視疾。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: he visited Prince Yuan Cheng’s palace to inquire after an illness.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, he called at Prince Yuan Cheng’s house to see the sick.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔諸州死罪可疑者詳審以聞。

translations.literal: Day bingxu, edict: where death sentences in the circuits were doubtful, they were to be reviewed in detail and reported.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, doubtful capital cases in the circuits were ordered fully reviewed.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰，詔伎術官未升朝特賜緋紫者勿佩魚。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renchen, edict: technical officers not yet in court rank who had been specially given crimson or purple were not to wear fish insignia.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, renchen: technical officers below court rank who held crimson or purple by special grant could not wear fish badges.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，聖像至。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: the sacred images arrived.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the sacred images reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔聖像所經郡邑減系囚死罪，流以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day bingwu, edict: in commanderies and counties the sacred images passed through, capital crimes among prisoners were reduced and exile or below were released.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, counties along the image route cut capital sentences and freed those below exile.

sentences.zh: 升建安軍為真州。

translations.literal: Jian’an Army was promoted to Zhen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jian’an Army was elevated to Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，謁聖像，奉安于玉清宮。

translations.literal: Day yimao: he paid respects to the sacred images and installed them at the Jade Pure Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, he received the images and enshrined them at Jade Pure Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，遣使奏告諸陵。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: envoys were sent to report at the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, envoys announced the event at the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 六月壬戌，惟和卒。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renxu: Weihe died.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renxu: Weihe died.

sentences.zh: 趙州黑龍見。

translations.literal: A black dragon appeared in Zhao prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A black dragon was seen in Zhaozhou.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，壽丘獻紫莖金芝。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: purple-stem golden fungus was presented from Shou Hill.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Shou Hill presented purple-stem golden fungus.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，保安軍雨，河溢，兵民溺死，遣使振之。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Baojun Army had rain; the river overflowed; soldiers and civilians drowned; envoys were sent to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Baojun floods drowned troops and civilians; relief envoys were dispatched.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔翰林學士陳彭年等刪定《三司編敕》。

translations.literal: Day bingzi, edict: Hanlin academician Chen Pengnian and others were to revise the Three Offices Compiled Statutes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Chen Pengnian and fellow Hanlin readers were set to revise the Three Offices statutes.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，崇飾諸州黃帝祠廟。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Yellow Emperor temples in the circuits were splendidly refurbished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Yellow Emperor shrines throughout the realm were refurbished.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸巳，上清宮道場獲龍於香合中。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guisi: at the Supreme Purity Palace ritual ground a dragon was obtained in the incense casket.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, guisi: a dragon was found in the incense box at Supreme Purity Palace’s ritual ground.

sentences.zh: 己亥，中書門下表請元德皇后祔廟。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the Secretariat and Chancellery memorialized requesting that Empress Yuan De be enshrined in the Imperial Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the Secretariat asked that Empress Yuan De join the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 庚子，行配祔禮。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: the associated enshrinement rite was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the associated enshrinement rite was carried out.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔天下勿稅農器。

translations.literal: Day guimao, edict: throughout the realm farm tools were not to be taxed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, farm implements were exempted from tax empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 己酉，亳州官吏父老三千三百人詣闕請謁太清宮。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: three thousand three hundred Bozhou officials, fathers, and elders came to the capital requesting audience at the Grand Supreme Purity Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, 3,300 Bozhou officials and elders petitioned to worship at the Grand Supreme Purity Palace.

sentences.zh: 八月庚申，詔來春親謁亳州太清宮。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengshen, edict: in the coming spring he would personally worship at the Bozhou Grand Supreme Purity Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, gengshen: he announced a spring pilgrimage to Bozhou’s Grand Supreme Purity Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以丁謂為奉祀經度制置使。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Ding Wei was made sacrifice commissioner for planning and arrangements.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Ding Wei became chief sacrifice planner for the tour.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，禁太清宮五里內樵采。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: woodcutting was forbidden within five li of the Grand Supreme Purity Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, logging was banned within five li of the Grand Supreme Purity Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚午，加號太上老君混元上德皇帝。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: the honorific title of the Supreme Lord Lao was augmented to Emperor of Primal Virtue and Supreme Virtue of the Primal One.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Supreme Lord Lao received the augmented title Emperor of Primal Virtue.

sentences.zh: 置禮儀院。

translations.literal: The Court of Ritual Usages was established.
translations.idiomatic: A Court of Ritual Usages was founded.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，幸元偁宮視疾。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengyin: he visited Prince Yuan Cheng’s palace to inquire after an illness.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, gengyin: he called at Prince Yuan Cheng’s residence.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，出玉宸殿種占城稻示百官。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: he displayed Champa rice grown in the Jade Hall planted before the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, he showed officials Champa rice grown in the Jade Hall.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛酉，元德皇后祔廟。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinyou: Empress Yuan De was enshrined in the Imperial Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, xinyou: Empress Yuan De entered the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 甲子，亳州太清宮枯檜再生。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: the withered cypress at Bozhou’s Grand Supreme Purity Palace put forth new growth.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Bozhou’s dead cypress at the Grand Supreme Purity Palace sprouted anew.

sentences.zh: 真源縣菽麥再實。

translations.literal: Beans and wheat in Zhenyuan county bore a second crop.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenyuan county’s beans and wheat ripened twice.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，謁玉清昭應宮。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: he worshipped at the Jade Pure Manifest Response Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, he worshipped at Jade Pure Manifest Response Palace.

sentences.zh: 己卯，作《步虛詞》付道門。

translations.literal: Day jimao: he composed “Pacing the Void” verses and entrusted them to the Daoist clergy.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, he wrote “Pacing the Void” hymns for the Daoist clergy.

sentences.zh: 壬午，降聖節賜會如先天節儀。

translations.literal: Day renwu: the Descent of Sageliness festival grant assembly followed the Prior Heaven festival protocol.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Descent of Sageliness feasts followed Prior Heaven festival rules.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛亥，幸元偁宮視疾。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinhai: he visited Prince Yuan Cheng’s palace to inquire after an illness.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, xinhai: he again called at Prince Yuan Cheng’s house.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，賜御史台《九經》、諸史。

translations.literal: Day guichou: the Censorate was given the Nine Classics and the various histories.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the Censorate received the Nine Classics and standard histories.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，判亳州丁謂獻芝草三萬七千本。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Bozhou prefect Ding Wei presented thirty-seven thousand stalks of fungus plant.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Bozhou prefect Ding Wei offered thirty-seven thousand fungus plants.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，龜茲遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Kucha sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Kucha sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuwu new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, new moon wuwu: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，涇原鈐轄曹瑋言發兵討原州界撥藏族違命者，捕獲甚眾。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Jingyuan commissioner Cao Wei reported dispatching troops to punish disobedient Bo Tibetans on Yuan prefecture’s border; very many were captured.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Cao Wei of Jingyuan reported a punitive campaign against Bo Tibetans on Yuanzhou’s border with many captives.

sentences.zh: 回鶻遣使來貢。

translations.literal: The Uighurs sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Uighur envoys brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 己巳，天書扶侍使趙安仁等上奉天書車輅、鼓吹、儀仗。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Heavenly Book attendants Zhao Anren and others presented the Heavenly Book carriage, music, and regalia.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Zhao Anren and fellow Heavenly Book attendants presented the sacred carriage, music, and regalia.

sentences.zh: 壬申，獻天書於朝元殿，遂告玉清昭應宮及太廟。

translations.literal: Day renshen: the Heavenly Book was presented at Chaoyuan Hall, then announced at the Jade Pure Manifest Response Palace and the Imperial Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the Heavenly Book was shown at Chaoyuan Hall, then proclaimed at Jade Pure Palace and the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，幸開寶寺、上清宮。

translations.literal: Day yihai: he visited Kaibao Temple and the Supreme Purity Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, he visited Kaibao Temple and Supreme Purity Palace.

sentences.zh: 己卯，幸太一宮。

translations.literal: Day jimao: he visited the Grand Unity Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, he called at the Grand Unity Palace.

sentences.zh: 戎、瀘蠻寇平。

translations.literal: Rong and Lu barbarian raids were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Rong and Lu frontier raids were suppressed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，西蕃、高州蠻、龜茲來貢。

translations.literal: That year the Western Tibetans, Gaozhou barbarians, and Kucha came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Western Tibetans, Gaozhou tribes, and Kucha sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月辛丑，慮囚。

translations.literal: Seventh year, spring, first month, day xinchou: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: First month, xinchou: the emperor reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，車駕奉天書發京師。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the imperial carriage bearing the Heavenly Book departed the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the court set out from the capital bearing the Heavenly Book.

sentences.zh: 丙午，次奉元宮。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: he halted at Fengyuan Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the procession stopped at Fengyuan Palace.

sentences.zh: 判亳州丁謂獻白鹿一，芝九萬五千本。

translations.literal: Bozhou prefect Ding Wei presented one white deer and ninety-five thousand fungus plants.
translations.idiomatic: Bozhou prefect Ding Wei offered one white deer and ninety-five thousand fungus stalks.

sentences.zh: 戊申，王旦上混元上德皇帝冊寶。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Wang Dan presented the seals and regalia of the Emperor of Primal Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Wang Dan presented the Primal Virtue Emperor’s seals and regalia.

sentences.zh: 己酉，朝謁太清宮。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: he worshipped at the Grand Supreme Purity Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, he worshipped at the Grand Supreme Purity Palace.

sentences.zh: 天書升輅，雨雪倏霽，法駕繼進，佳氣彌望。

translations.literal: As the Heavenly Book ascended the carriage, snow and rain suddenly cleared; the imperial procession followed; auspicious vapor filled the view.
translations.idiomatic: Snow and rain broke as the Heavenly Book mounted its carriage; the procession advanced through auspicious mist.

sentences.zh: 是夜，月重輪，幸先天觀、廣靈洞霄宮。

translations.literal: That night the moon showed double halos; he visited the Prior Heaven Abbey and the Broad Spirit Grotto Heaven Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: That night double lunar halos appeared; he visited Prior Heaven Abbey and Broad Spirit Grotto Heaven Abbey.

sentences.zh: 曲赦亳州及車駕所經流以下罪。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was granted for Bozhou and all places the carriage passed—exile and below.
translations.idiomatic: Bozhou and every county on the route received partial amnesty through exile and below.

sentences.zh: 升亳州為集慶軍節度，減歲賦十之二。

translations.literal: Bozhou was promoted to Jiqing Army circuit; its annual tax was reduced by two-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: Bozhou became Jiqing circuit and its annual levy was cut twenty percent.

sentences.zh: 改奉元宮為明道宮。

translations.literal: Fengyuan Palace was changed to Bright Way Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The court renamed Fengyuan Palace Bright Way Palace.

sentences.zh: 太史言含譽星見。

translations.literal: The imperial astronomer reported the appearance of the Holding-Radiance star.
translations.idiomatic: Court astronomers reported the Holding-Radiance star.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，禦均慶樓，賜酺三日。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: at Junqing Tower he granted three days of communal feasting.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, three days of public feasting were granted at Junqing Tower.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔所過頓遞侵民田者，給復二年。

translations.literal: Day renzi, edict: where relay stations had encroached on private fields, two years’ tax remission was given.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, relay stations that had taken cropland owed two years’ tax forgiveness.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，建南京歸德殿，赦境內及京畿車駕所過流以下罪。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: the Guiding Virtue Hall of Nanjing was built; within the circuit and the capital districts the carriage passed, exile and below were amnestied.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Nanjing’s Guiding Virtue Hall rose and the route received amnesty through exile and below.

sentences.zh: 追贈太祖幕府元勳僚舊，錄常參官逮事者並進秩，欲授子孫者聽。

translations.literal: Taizu’s former staff and companions in the military government were posthumously enfeoffed; regular-attendance officials who had served them were all advanced in rank, and those wishing to grant offices to descendants were permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu’s old staff were enfeoffed posthumously; their former colleagues were promoted, with offices for descendants at will.

sentences.zh: 作鴻慶宮。

translations.literal: Great Celebration Palace was built.
translations.idiomatic: Great Celebration Palace was erected.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，次襄邑縣，皇子來朝。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuwu: he halted at Xiangyi county; the princes came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, wuwu: at Xiangyi the princes came to audience.

sentences.zh: 庚申，夏州趙德明遣使詣行闕朝貢。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Zhao Deming of Xia prefecture sent envoys to the traveling palace with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Xiazhou’s Zhao Deming sent envoys to the traveling court.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，至自亳州。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: he returned from Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the court returned from Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔天地壇非執事輒臨者斬。

translations.literal: Day bingyin, edict: anyone not holding office who entered the Heaven and Earth altars was to be beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, unauthorized entry to the Heaven and Earth altars was made a capital crime.

sentences.zh: 辛未，饗太廟。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: the Imperial Temple was feasted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, a feast was offered at the Imperial Temple.

sentences.zh: 壬申，恭謝天地，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Day renshen: heaven and earth were thanked with reverence; the realm was greatly amnestied.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, heaven and earth were thanked and a great amnesty proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，益州鑄大鐵錢。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Yizhou cast great iron cash.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Yizhou began casting large iron coins.

sentences.zh: 三月，城淯井監。

translations.literal: Third month: Yujing prefectural seat was walled.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: Yujing seat received new walls.

sentences.zh: 癸己，雄州甲仗庫火。

translations.literal: Day guisi: the arms depot at Xiongzhou burned.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Xiongzhou’s arms depot burned.

sentences.zh: 甲午，制加宰相王旦、向敏中、楚王元佐、相王元偓、舒王元偁、榮王元儼樞密使、同平章事。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: an edict advanced Grand Councilors Wang Dan and Xiang Minzhong, Prince of Chu Yuan Zuo, Prince of Xiang Yuan Wei, Prince of Shu Yuan Cheng, and Prince of Rong Yuan Yan to Privy Council commissioner and co-grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Wang Dan, Xiang Minzhong, and the Chu, Xiang, Shu, and Rong princes were made privy commissioners and co-councilors.

sentences.zh: 乙未，宴翔鸞閣。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: a banquet was held at the Soaring Phoenix Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the court feasted at Soaring Phoenix Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，發粟振儀州饑。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: grain was issued to relieve famine in Yi prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, grain relief reached famine-stricken Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 復諸州觀察使兼刺史。

translations.literal: Observation commissioners in the circuits again concurrently served as prefects.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit observation commissioners again held concurrent prefectural posts.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，幸元偁宮視疾。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: he visited Prince Yuan Cheng’s palace to inquire after an illness.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, he called at Prince Yuan Cheng’s residence.

sentences.zh: 丁未，封皇子慶國公。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the prince was enfeoffed as Duke of Qing State.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, a prince was enfeoffed Duke of Qing State.

sentences.zh: 青州民趙嵩百一十歲，詔存問之。

translations.literal: Zhao Song of Qing prefecture was one hundred ten years old; an edict ordered him comforted and inquired after.
translations.idiomatic: Qingzhou’s Zhao Song, aged 110, received an imperial inquiry and gifts.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰，王旦為兗州景靈宮朝修使，乙未，又為天書刻玉使。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renchen: Wang Dan was made Yanzhou Splendid Spirit Palace court-ritual commissioner; on yiwei he was also made Heavenly Book jade-carving commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, renchen: Wang Dan took Yanzhou Splendid Spirit ritual duty; on yiwei he also carved the Heavenly Book jade.

sentences.zh: 涇原言葉施族大首領豔般率族歸順。

translations.literal: Jingyuan reported that Yeshi tribe great chieftain Yanban led his tribe in submission.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyuan reported Yeshi chieftain Yanban submitting with his clan.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯，禁文字斥用黃帝名號故事。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yimao: written characters derogating the Yellow Emperor’s name and titles were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, yimao: texts insulting the Yellow Emperor’s name or titles were banned.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，眉州通判董榮受賕鬻獄，長安知縣王文龜酗酒濫刑，並投荒裔。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Meizhou vice-prefect Dong Rong took bribes and sold justice; Chang’an magistrate Wang Wen’gui drank heavily and abused punishments—both were exiled to the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Dong Rong of Meizhou and Wang Wen’gui of Chang’an were exiled for bribery and judicial abuse.

sentences.zh: 戊午，戒州縣官吏決罪逾法。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: prefectural and county officials were warned against sentencing beyond the law.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, local magistrates were warned not to exceed statutory punishments.

sentences.zh: 壬申，封婉儀楊氏為淑妃。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Gentle Conduct Lady Yang was made Fair Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Gentle Conduct Lady Yang became Fair Consort.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，樞密使王欽若罷為吏部尚書，陳堯叟為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Privy Council Commissioner Wang Qinruo was removed to Minister of Personnel; Chen Yaozi to Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Wang Qinruo left the privy council for Personnel; Chen Yaozi for Revenue.

sentences.zh: 以寇准為樞密使、同平章事。

translations.literal: Kou Zhun was made Privy Council commissioner and co-grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Kou Zhun became privy commissioner and co-grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔棣州經水，流民歸業者給復三年。

translations.literal: Day bingzi, edict: refugees from Di prefecture who returned to their occupations were given three years’ tax remission.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Dizhou refugees who resumed farming received three years without tax.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑，交州李公蘊敗鶴柘蠻，獻捷。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinchou: Li Gongyun of Jiaozhou defeated the Hezhe barbarians and presented a victory report.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, xinchou: Jiaozhou’s Li Gongyun beat the Hezhe and sent a victory memorial.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Venus shone in daylight.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以同州觀察使王嗣宗、內客省使曹利用並為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Tongzhou observation commissioner Wang Sizong and Inner Palace commissioner Cao Liyong were both made vice commissioners of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Wang Sizong and Cao Liyong became privy vice commissioners.

sentences.zh: 八月甲寅，置景靈宮使，以向敏中為之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiayin: the Splendid Spirit Palace commissioner was established; Xiang Minzhong was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jiayin: Splendid Spirit Palace commissioner was created for Xiang Minzhong.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，除江、淮、兩浙被災民租。

translations.literal: Day yimao: rent was remitted for disaster victims in Jiang, Huai, and the two Zhes.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, flood and drought victims in Jianghuai and the two Zhes were freed from rent.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，楊光習坐擅領兵出砦，又誣軍中謀殺司馬張從吉，配隸鄧州。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Yang Guangxi, for leading troops out of the stockade without authorization and also falsely accusing the army of plotting to kill Registrar Zhang Congji, was assigned penal service at Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Yang Guangxi was banished to Dengzhou for unauthorized sorties and framing troops for murder.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，給河東沿邊將士皮裘氈襪。

translations.literal: Day yichou: fur coats and felt socks were given to Hedong frontier officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Hedong frontier troops received fur coats and felt socks.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，河決澶州。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: the Yellow River burst its banks at Dan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the Yellow River broke at Danzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，命內臣奉安太祖、太宗聖像于鴻慶宮。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: inner attendants were ordered to install the sacred images of Taizu and Taizong at Great Celebration Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, eunuchs enshrined Taizu and Taizong’s sacred images at Great Celebration Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔嶺南戍兵代還日，人給裝錢五百。

translations.literal: Day xinsi, edict: when Lingnan garrison troops were rotated home, each man was given five hundred cash for travel expenses.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Lingnan garrisons rotating home received five hundred cash travel allowance each.

sentences.zh: 九月丙戌，含譽星再見。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingxu: the Holding-Radiance star appeared again.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, bingxu: the Holding-Radiance star returned.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，尊上玉皇聖號曰太上開天執符禦曆含真體道玉皇大天帝。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the Jade Emperor’s honorific was elevated to Great Jade Emperor of the Supreme Opening Heaven, Holding Talismans, Governing the Calendar, Embodying Truth, and Observing the Way.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the Jade Emperor received the grand honorific Great Jade Emperor of supreme heaven and cosmic order.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，禦試服勤詞學、經明行修舉人。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: the palace examination was held for Diligent Learning in Poetry and Prose and Classicist of Clear Conduct graduates.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, the court examined Diligent Learning and Classicist of Clear Conduct graduates.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，幸五嶽觀。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: he visited the Five Sacred Peaks Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, he called at the Five Sacred Peaks Abbey.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月乙酉，濱州河溢。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day yiyou: the river overflowed at Bin prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, yiyou: floods struck Binzhou.

sentences.zh: 玉清昭應宮成，詔減諸路系囚罪流以下一等。

translations.literal: The Jade Pure Manifest Response Palace was completed; an edict reduced by one grade all prisoners in the circuits guilty of exile or below.
translations.idiomatic: When Jade Pure Palace was finished, circuit prisoners at exile or below had sentences reduced one grade.

sentences.zh: 己丑，加王旦司空、修宮使。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Wang Dan was advanced to Minister of Works and palace-repair commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Wang Dan became Minister of Works and palace-repair commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，禦乾元門觀酺。

translations.literal: Day renchen: at Qianyuan Gate he viewed communal feasting.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, he watched public feasts from Qianyuan Gate.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸丑朔，日當食不虧。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guichou new moon: an eclipse was due but did not darken.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, new moon guichou: an eclipse was predicted but the sun did not dim.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔王欽若等五人各舉京朝、幕職、州縣官詳練刑典、曉時務、任邊寄者二人。

translations.literal: Day bingchen, edict: Wang Qinruo and four others were each to recommend two capital, bureau, or local officials skilled in penal codes, current affairs, and frontier duty.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Wang Qinruo and four colleagues were each to nominate two proven frontier and legal experts.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔川、峽、閩、廣轉運、提點刑獄官察屬吏貪墨慘刻者。

translations.literal: Day dingsi, edict: transport and judicial commissioners in Sichuan, Fujian, and Lingnan were to investigate greedy and cruel subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Sichuan, Fujian, and Lingnan transport and judicial officers were told to purge corrupt subordinates.

sentences.zh: 己未，作元符觀。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the Primal Talisman Abbey was built.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Primal Talisman Abbey was founded.

sentences.zh: 庚申，契丹使蕭延寧等辭歸國。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Khitan envoys Xiao Yanning and others took leave to return home.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Khitan envoys led by Xiao Yanning departed.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，加楚王元佐尚書令，相王元偓太尉，榮王元儼兼中書令，忠武軍節度使魏咸信同平章事，余並進秩。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Prince of Chu Yuan Zuo was made Director of the Imperial Secretariat; Prince of Xiang Yuan Wei Grand Marshal; Prince of Rong Yuan Yan concurrent Secretariat Director; Wuzhong military commissioner Wei Xianxin co-grand councilor; the rest were advanced in rank.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Yuan Zuo became Secretariat director, Yuan Wei grand marshal, Yuan Yan concurrent director, Wei Xianxin co-councilor, and others were promoted.

sentences.zh: 涇原路請築籠竿城。

translations.literal: Jingyuan circuit requested building Longgan city.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyuan asked permission to build Longgan fortress.

sentences.zh: 是歲，夏州、西涼府、高麗、女真來貢。

translations.literal: That year Xia prefecture, Xiliang, Goryeo, and Jurchen came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Xia, Xiliang, Goryeo, and Jurchen sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 淮南、江、浙饑，除其租。

translations.literal: Huainan and Jiang-Zhe suffered famine; their rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Famine in Huainan and Jiang-Zhe brought rent remission.

sentences.zh: 天下戶九百五萬五千七百二十九，口二千一百九十七萬六千九百六十五。

translations.literal: Households in the realm numbered 9,055,729; persons 21,976,965.
translations.idiomatic: The empire counted 9,055,729 households and 21,976,965 persons.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月壬午朔，謁玉清昭應宮，奉表告尊上玉皇大天帝聖號，奉安刻玉天書于寶符閣，還禦崇德殿受賀，赦天下，非十惡、枉法贓及己殺人者鹹除之。

translations.literal: Eighth year, spring, first month, day renwu new moon: he worshipped at the Jade Pure Manifest Response Palace, presented a memorial announcing the Jade Emperor’s honorific, and installed the carved-jade Heavenly Book in the Talisman Treasure Pavilion; returning, he received congratulations at Chongde Hall, amnestied the realm, and all except the ten abominations, corrupt judgment, and prior murder were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: New moon renwu: he worshipped at Jade Pure Palace, enshrined the jade Heavenly Book, amnestied the realm at Chongde Hall—sparing only capital crimes, judicial corruption, and prior murder.

sentences.zh: 文武官滿三歲者，有司考課以聞。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials after three years had their offices review performance and report.
translations.idiomatic: After three years, civil and military officers faced performance review.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔環州緣邊卒人賜薪水錢。

translations.literal: Day yiyou, edict: frontier soldiers at Huanzhou were given firewood and water allowances.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Huanzhou frontier troops received firewood and water pay.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，置清衛二指揮奉宮觀。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: the Pure and Guard two commands were established to serve the palaces and abbeys.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Pure and Guard commands were created for palace and abbey service.

sentences.zh: 乙未，皇女入道。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: an imperial daughter entered the Dao.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, a princess took Daoist orders.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，徙棣州城。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Di prefectural seat was moved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Dizhou’s seat was relocated.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔王欽若等舉供奉官至殿直有武幹者一人。

translations.literal: Day gengxu, edict: Wang Qinruo and others were to recommend one palace attendant through palace guard with military talent.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Wang Qinruo and colleagues were to nominate one martial palace guard for promotion.

sentences.zh: 二月，泗州周憲百五歲，詔賜束帛。

translations.literal: Second month: Zhou Xian of Sizhou was one hundred five years old; an edict bestowed silks.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: 105-year-old Zhou Xian of Sizhou received silks from the throne.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，宗正寺火。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: the Directorate of the Imperial Clan burned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the Imperial Clan directorate burned.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，唃廝囉、立遵貢名馬。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Gusiluo and Li Zun presented famous horses.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Gusiluo and Li Zun sent famous horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以元佐為天策上將軍、興元牧，賜劍履上殿，詔書不名。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Yuan Zuo was made Celestial Stratagem generalissimo and Xingyuan governor; sword and shoes in the hall and edicts without naming him were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Yuan Zuo became Celestial Stratagem generalissimo of Xingyuan with sword in hall and unnamed edicts.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，遣使巡撫淮、浙路。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: envoys were sent to tour and comfort the Huai-Zhe circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, envoys were dispatched to inspect Huai and Zhe.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，祈雨。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: rain was prayed for.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the court prayed for rain.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔進士六舉、諸科九舉者許奏名。

translations.literal: Day bingzi, edict: jinshi after six attempts and other-degree candidates after nine were permitted to present their names.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, candidates failing six jinshi or nine specialty tries could still enter the lists.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，大雨。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: heavy rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, torrential rain fell.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉，幸元偓宮視疾。

translations.literal: Third month, day yiyou: he visited Prince Yuan Wei’s palace to inquire after an illness.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, yiyou: he called at Prince Yuan Wei’s residence.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，宴宗室，射于苑中。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: the imperial clan was feasted and archery held in the garden.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, the clan feasted and shot arrows in the garden.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，禦試禮部貢舉人。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the palace examination of Ministry of Rites tributary graduates was held.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Ministry of Rites graduates faced the palace examination.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛酉，賜宰相《五臣論》。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinyou: the Five Ministers Commentary was bestowed on the grand councilors.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, xinyou: grand councilors received the Five Ministers Commentary.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以寇准為武勝軍節度使、同平章事，王欽若、陳堯叟並為樞密使、同平章事。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Kou Zhun was made Wusheng military commissioner and co-grand councilor; Wang Qinruo and Chen Yaozi were both made Privy Council commissioners and co-grand councilors.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Kou Zhun went to Wusheng as commissioner while Wang Qinruo and Chen Yaozi rejoined the privy council.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，德彝卒。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Deyi died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Deyi died.

sentences.zh: 壬申，榮王元儼宮火，延及殿閣內庫。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Prince of Rong Yuan Yan’s palace burned, spreading to halls, pavilions, and the inner treasury.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Prince of Rong Yuan Yan’s palace fire reached halls and the inner treasury.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔求直言。

translations.literal: Day guiyou, edict: blunt counsel was sought.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the throne called for frank memorials.

sentences.zh: 命丁謂為大內修葺使。

translations.literal: Ding Wei was made Inner Palace repair commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Wei was named Inner Palace repair commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，王膺坐應詔言事乖繆貶。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Wang Ying, for responding to an edict with errant words, was demoted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Wang Ying was demoted for a blundered edict response.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，榮王元儼罷武信軍節度使，降封端王。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renwu: Prince of Rong Yuan Yan was removed as Wuxin military commissioner and demoted to Prince of Duan.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, renwu: Prince of Rong Yuan Yan lost Wuxin command and became Prince of Duan.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，熒惑犯軒轅。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Mars trespassed against the Chariot constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Mars crossed the Chariot asterism.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，廢內侍省黃門。

translations.literal: Day renchen: the Yellow Gate office of the Inner Attendant Service was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the Inner Attendant Service’s Yellow Gate office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 禁金飾服器。

translations.literal: Gold ornament on clothing and vessels was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Gold decoration on dress and vessels was banned.

sentences.zh: 庚子，放宮人一百八十四人。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: one hundred eighty-four palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, 184 palace women were sent home.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiyou new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, new moon jiyou: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔諸州以《禦制七條》刻石。
