translations.literal: Day xinwei, edict: the circuits were to carve the Imperial Seven Articles on stone.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the Imperial Seven Articles were ordered carved in every circuit.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，惟忠卒。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Weizhong died.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Weizhong died.

sentences.zh: 閏月己卯，赦天下。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day jimao: the realm was amnestied.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, jimao: a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，王欽若上《彤管懿範》。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Wang Qinruo presented the Exemplary Conduct of the Inner Quarters.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Wang Qinruo submitted Exemplary Conduct of the Inner Quarters.

sentences.zh: 七月丙辰，以諸州牛疫免牛稅一年。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day bingchen: because of cattle plague in the circuits, the cattle tax was remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, bingchen: cattle plague brought a one-year cattle-tax holiday.

sentences.zh: 戊午，王嗣宗為大同軍節度使。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Wang Sizong was made Datong military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Wang Sizong became Datong military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，幸相王元偓新宮。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: he visited Prince of Xiang Yuan Wei’s new palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, he toured Prince of Xiang Yuan Wei’s new residence.

sentences.zh: 以宮城火，詔諸王徙宮於外。

translations.literal: Because the palace city burned, an edict ordered the princes to move their residences outside.
translations.idiomatic: After the palace city fire, princes were ordered to relocate outside the walls.

sentences.zh: 丙子，幸瑞聖園觀稼，宴射于水心殿。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: he visited Auspicious Sage Garden to view the crops, feasted, and shot arrows at the Water Heart Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, he inspected crops at Auspicious Sage Garden and shot arrows at Water Heart Hall.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯，大理少卿閻允恭、開封判官韓允坐枉獄除名。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jimao: Assistant Director of Justice Yan Yonggong and Kaifeng assistant magistrate Han Yun, for wrongful imprisonment, were stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jimao: Yan Yonggong and Han Yun were dismissed for wrongful imprisonment.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔京兆、河中府、陝、同、華、虢等州貸貧民麥種。

translations.literal: Day wuxu, edict: Jingzhao, Hezhong, Shaan, Tong, Hua, Guo, and other prefectures were to lend wheat seed to the poor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, the capital region lent wheat seed to impoverished farmers.

sentences.zh: 九月，注輦國貢土物、珍珠衫帽。

translations.literal: Ninth month: the Chola state presented local products and pearl caps and robes.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Chola sent local goods and pearl caps and robes.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，唃廝囉聚眾數十萬，請討平夏人以自效。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Gusiluo gathered several hundred thousand men and asked to campaign against the Ping Xia people to prove his loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Gusiluo mustered hundreds of thousands and offered to crush the Ping Xia for the court.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，宴宗室，射于後苑。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the imperial clan was feasted and archery held in the rear garden.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the clan feasted and shot in the rear garden.

sentences.zh: 己巳，賜注輦使袍服、牲酒。

translations.literal: Day jisi: the Chola envoy was given robes and livestock wine.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the Chola envoy received robes and ceremonial wine.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙巳，王欽若上《聖祖先天紀》。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yisi: Wang Qinruo presented the Chronicle of the Sagely Ancestor’s Prior Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, yisi: Wang Qinruo submitted Chronicle of the Sagely Ancestor’s Prior Heaven.

sentences.zh: 戊申，回鶻呵羅等來貢。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Uighur Heluo and others came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Uighur Heluo and others sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉，相王元偓加兼中書令，端王元儼進封彭王。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinyou: Prince of Xiang Yuan Wei was additionally made concurrent Secretariat Director; Prince of Duan Yuan Yan was advanced to Prince of Peng.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, xinyou: Yuan Wei gained concurrent Secretariat director rank; Yuan Yan became Prince of Peng.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，高麗使同東女真來貢。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Goryeo envoys came with Eastern Jurchen tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Goryeo envoys arrived with Eastern Jurchen tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅，皇子冠。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuyin: the prince received capping.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, wuyin: a prince underwent capping.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，侍禁楊承吉使西蕃還，以地理圖進。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Palace attendant Yang Chengji returned from mission to the Western Tibetans and presented a geographical map.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Yang Chengji returned from Tibet with a geographical map.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，皇子慶國公封壽春郡王。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the Duke of Qing State was enfeoffed as Prince of Shouchun.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the Duke of Qing State became Prince of Shouchun.

sentences.zh: 是歲，占城、宗哥族及西蕃首領來貢。

translations.literal: That year Champa, the Zongge tribe, and Western Tibetan chieftains came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Champa, Zongge, and Western Tibetan leaders sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 坊州大雨，河溢。

translations.literal: Fang prefecture had heavy rain; the river overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: Fangzhou’s heavy rains burst the river banks.

sentences.zh: 陝西饑。

translations.literal: Shaanxi suffered famine.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi faced famine.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月丙辰，置會靈觀使，以丁謂為之，加刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Ninth year, spring, first month, day bingchen: the Assembly of Spirits Abbey commissioner was established; Ding Wei was appointed and advanced to Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: First month, bingchen: Ding Wei became Assembly of Spirits commissioner and Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以張士遜、崔遵度為壽春郡王友。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Zhang Shixun and Cui Zundu were made companions to the Prince of Shouchun.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Zhang Shixun and Cui Zundu became tutors to the Prince of Shouchun.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，王旦等上《兩朝國史》。

translations.literal: Second month, day dinghai: Wang Dan and others presented the National History of the Two Reigns.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, dinghai: Wang Dan and colleagues submitted the Two-Reigns National History.

sentences.zh: 戊子，加旦守司徒，修史官以下進秩、賜物有差。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Wang Dan was advanced to acting Minister of Education; historiographers and below were advanced and gifts given in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Wang Dan became acting Minister of Education and the historiographic staff were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔以皇子就學之所名資善堂。

translations.literal: Day jiawu, edict: the prince’s study was named the Hall of Cherishing Goodness.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the heir’s school was named Hall of Cherishing Goodness.

sentences.zh: 延州蕃部饑，貸以邊穀。

translations.literal: Yanzhou barbarian tribes suffered famine; frontier grain was lent them.
translations.idiomatic: Famine among Yanzhou tribes was met with frontier grain loans.

sentences.zh: 三月丙午，除雷州無名商稅錢。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingwu: Leizhou’s tax on unnamed goods was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, bingwu: Leizhou’s levy on unlisted merchandise was abolished.

sentences.zh: 秦州曹瑋撫捍蕃境得宜，詔嘉之。

translations.literal: Cao Wei of Qinzhou pacified and defended the barbarian frontier appropriately; an edict praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Qinzhou’s Cao Wei was commended for sound frontier governance.

sentences.zh: 己酉，王欽若上《寶文統錄》。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Wang Qinruo presented the Comprehensive Record of Precious Literature.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Wang Qinruo submitted the Comprehensive Record of Precious Literature.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以西蕃宗哥族李立遵為保順軍節度使。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Li Lizun of the Western Tibetan Zongge tribe was made Baoshun military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Zongge’s Li Lizun became Baoshun military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔舉官必擇廉能。

translations.literal: Day renxu, edict: in recommending officials, integrity and ability must be chosen.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, nominators were told to choose honest and capable men.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，置修玉牒官。

translations.literal: Day guihai: jade-register revision officers were established.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, officers to revise the jade genealogy register were appointed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，著作佐郎高清以贓賄仗脊，配沙門島。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Editorial Assistant Gao Qing, for bribery, was beaten at the waist and assigned to Shamen Island.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Editorial Assistant Gao Qing was flogged and exiled to Shamen Island for bribery.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚辰，周伯星見。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengchen: the Zhoubo comet appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, gengchen: the Zhoubo comet was seen.

sentences.zh: 丙申，賜天下酺。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: the realm was granted communal feasting.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, empire-wide public feasting was granted.

sentences.zh: 振延州蕃族饑。

translations.literal: Yanzhou barbarian tribes suffering famine were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Famine relief reached Yanzhou’s tribal peoples.

sentences.zh: 庚子，幸陳堯叟第視疾。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: he visited Chen Yaozi’s residence to inquire after an illness.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, he called at Chen Yaozi’s house to see the sick.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以唐相元稹七世孫為台州司馬。

translations.literal: Day renyin: a seventh-generation descendant of Tang chancellor Yuan Zhen was made Taizhou marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Yuan Zhen’s seventh-generation descendant was posted Taizhou marshal.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳，邠甯環慶部署王守斌言夏州蕃騎千五百來寇慶州，內屬蕃部擊走之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yisi: Bin-Ning-Huan-Qing deployment commissioner Wang Shoubin reported that fifteen hundred Xia barbarian horsemen raided Qingzhou and were driven off by affiliated tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, yisi: Wang Shoubin reported 1,500 Xia horsemen repulsed at Qingzhou by affiliated tribes.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，幸南宮視惟憲疾。

translations.literal: Day guichou: he visited the Southern Palace to inquire after Wei Xian’s illness.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, he called at the Southern Palace to see Wei Xian.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，惟憲卒。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Wei Xian died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Wei Xian died.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，毛屍等三族蕃官馮移埋率屬來歸，詔撫之。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the three Mao-corpse tribal officials led by Feng Yimai brought their dependents in submission; an edict comforted them.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Feng Yimai of the Mao-corpse tribes submitted with his people and was comforted.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔天下系囚死罪減等，流以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day bingchen, edict: throughout the realm prisoners guilty of capital crimes had sentences reduced and exile or below were released.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, capital sentences were commuted and lesser prisoners freed empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，向敏中為宮觀慶成使。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Xiang Minzhong was made abbey celebration-completion commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Xiang Minzhong became abbey celebration-completion commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲子，左天廄草場火。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: the Left Celestial Stable pasture burned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the Left Celestial Stable pasture burned.

sentences.zh: 庚午，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Venus shone in daylight.

sentences.zh: 六月戊寅，幸會靈觀，宴祝禧殿，癸未，京畿蝗。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuyin: he visited the Assembly of Spirits Abbey and feasted at Blessing Celebration Hall; on guiyou locusts struck the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, wuyin: he feasted at Assembly of Spirits Abbey; on guiyou locusts hit the capital region.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，撫水蠻寇宜州，廣南西路請便宜掩擊，許之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: Fushui barbarians raided Yizhou; the Guangnan West circuit requested discretionary strike; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Fushui tribes raided Yizhou; Guangnan West was authorized to strike at will.

sentences.zh: 丁未，增築京師新城。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the capital’s new outer wall was enlarged.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, the capital’s new outer wall was extended.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，開封府祥符縣蝗附草死者數里。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: in Kaifeng prefecture’s Xiangfu county locusts clung to grass and died for several li.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, locusts in Xiangfu county died clinging to grass for li on end.

sentences.zh: 戊午，停京城工役。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: capital construction projects were halted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, capital building works were suspended.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以畿內蝗，下詔戒郡縣。

translations.literal: Day guihai: because of locusts in the capital region, an edict warned the commanderies and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, locusts in the capital region brought warning edicts to local officials.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔京城禁樂一月。

translations.literal: Day jiazi, edict: music was forbidden in the capital for one month.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the capital banned music for a month.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，幸太乙宮、天清寺。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: he visited the Grand Unity Palace and Tianqing Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, he called at Grand Unity Palace and Tianqing Temple.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，知秦州曹瑋言伏羌砦蕃部廝雞波與宗哥族連結為亂，以兵夷其族帳。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renshen: Qinzhou prefect Cao Wei reported that the Fufu stockade Tibetan Sijibo had joined the Zongge tribe in rebellion and that troops had destroyed their clan encampments.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, renshen: Cao Wei reported Sijibo of Fufu stockade allied with Zongge and his clan camps destroyed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，令江、淮發運司留上供米五十萬以備饑年。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the Jiang-Huai transport office was ordered to retain five hundred thousand piculs of tribute rice against famine years.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Jiang-Huai transport was told to hold five hundred thousand piculs of tribute rice for famine.

sentences.zh: 磁、華、瀛、博等州蝗，不為災。

translations.literal: Ci, Hua, Ying, Bo, and other prefectures had locusts but they did no harm.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts appeared in Ci, Hua, Ying, and Bo but caused no damage.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，制玉皇聖號冊文。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the Jade Emperor’s honorific patent text was drafted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the Jade Emperor’s honorific patent was drafted.

sentences.zh: 以陳堯叟為右僕射。

translations.literal: Chen Yaozi was made Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yaozi became Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以旱，罷秋宴。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: because of drought, the autumn banquet was canceled.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, drought canceled the autumn banquet.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，群臣請受尊號冊寶，表五上，從之。

translations.literal: Day renchen: the ministers requested to receive the honorific patent and regalia; the memorial came up five times; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, after five memorials the ministers were allowed to receive the honorific patent and regalia.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，雄、霸河溢。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guimao: the Xiong and Ba rivers overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, guimao: the Xiong and Ba rivers flooded.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以丁謂為平江軍節度使。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Ding Wei was made Pingjiang military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Ding Wei became Pingjiang military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙午，陳彭年、王曾、張知白並參知政事。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Chen Pengnian, Wang Zeng, and Zhang Zhibai were all made Participation Administrators.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Chen Pengnian, Wang Zeng, and Zhang Zhibai joined the participation council.

sentences.zh: 丁未，曹瑋言宗哥唃廝囉、蕃部馬波叱臘、魚角蟬等寇伏羌砦，擊敗之，斬首千餘級。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Cao Wei reported that Zongge Gusiluo and the Tibetan chieftains Mabo Chila, Yujiao Chan, and others raided Fufu stockade; they were defeated and more than a thousand heads were taken.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Cao Wei reported defeating Gusiluo, Mabo Chila, and Yujiao Chan at Fufu stockade with over a thousand heads taken.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以不雨，罷重陽宴。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: because rain had not fallen, the Double Ninth banquet was canceled.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the Chrysanthemum feast was called off for lack of rain.

sentences.zh: 利州水，漂棧閣。

translations.literal: Waters at Li prefecture washed away plank roads.
translations.idiomatic: Floods in Lizhou tore out mountain plankways.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，雨。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin it finally rained.

sentences.zh: 督諸路捕蝗。

translations.literal: All circuits were ordered to capture locusts.
translations.idiomatic: Every circuit was told to hunt locusts.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔以旱蝗得雨，宜務稼省事及罷諸營造。

translations.literal: Day dingsi, edict: with drought and locusts now relieved by rain, farming and frugal government were to be stressed and all construction halted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he urged lean government and full fields now that rain had broken drought and locusts—and halted new building.

sentences.zh: 戊午，禁諸路貢瑞物。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: tribute of auspicious objects from all circuits was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he banned “lucky” curios sent up from the provinces.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，青州飛蝗赴海死，積海岸百餘里。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: flying locusts in Qing prefecture died entering the sea, piling along the coast for more than a hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Qingzhou’s locust swarms drowned in the sea and lined the shore for a hundred li.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔民有出私廩振貧乏者，三千石至八千石，第授助教、文學、上佐之秩。

translations.literal: Day jisi, edict: commoners who opened private granaries to relieve the poor, from three thousand to eight thousand piculs, were to be ranked and given assistant instructor, literary officer, or upper aide posts.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi private granary donors of three to eight thousand piculs were graded into minor official ranks.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，王欽若表上《翊聖保德真君傳》。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jimao: Wang Qinruo memorialized presenting the Record of the Sagely Protector of Virtue True Lord.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, jimao: Wang Qinruo submitted his hagiography of the Sagely Protector True Lord.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔馮拯等各舉殿直以上武幹者一人。

translations.literal: Day renshen, edict: Feng Zheng and each of the others was to recommend one palace attendant through palace direct rank with military talent.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Feng Zheng and his peers were each to name one proven soldier from the palace ranks.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，置直龍圖閣。

translations.literal: Day renchen: the Direct Dragon Diagram Hall was established.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the Direct Dragon Diagram Hall was founded.

sentences.zh: 十一月，會靈觀甘露降。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: sweet dew fell at the Hall of Numinous Communion.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month sweet dew appeared at the Hall of Numinous Communion.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔河、陝諸路州簡禁軍五百人。

translations.literal: Day yisi, edict: circuits along the Yellow and Shaanxi rivers were to select five hundred guardsmen per prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the He and Shaanxi circuits were told to draft five hundred guardsmen from each prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁未，河西節度使石普坐妄言災異，除名流賀州。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Hexi military commissioner Shi Pu was demoted for false talk of omens and exiled to He prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Shi Pu of Hexi was cashiered for bogus omens and sent to Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以唐裴度孫坦為鄭州助教。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Pei Tan, seventh-generation descendant of Tang’s Pei Du, was made Zhengzhou assistant instructor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Pei Tan, Pei Du’s seventh-generation heir, became an instructor at Zhengzhou.

sentences.zh: 是歲，西蕃宗哥族、邛部山后蠻、夏州、甘州來貢。

translations.literal: That year the Zongge tribe of Western Xia, the Later Qiong tribal chiefs, Xia prefecture, and Gan prefecture came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Zongge Xia, Qiong hill chiefs, Xiazhou, and Ganzhou all sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 諸州有隕霜害稼及水災者，遣使振恤，除其租。

translations.literal: Where prefectures suffered frost damage to crops or flood disaster, envoys were sent to relieve and comfort them and remit their rent.
translations.idiomatic: Frost- or flood-hit prefectures received relief envoys and tax waivers.

sentences.zh: 天禧元年春正月辛丑朔，改元。

translations.literal: First year of Tianxi, spring, first month, day xinchou new moon: the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxi year one, spring, xinchou new moon: the reign title changed.

sentences.zh: 詣玉清昭應宮薦獻，上玉皇大天帝寶冊、袞服。

translations.literal: He went to the Jade Pure Palace of Manifest Response to offer sacrifice, presenting the Jade Emperor’s precious register and robes.
translations.idiomatic: He sacrificed at the Jade Pure Manifest Response Palace and offered the Jade Emperor’s register and vestments.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，上聖祖寶冊。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the Sagely Ancestor’s precious register was presented.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the court presented the Sagely Ancestor’s register.

sentences.zh: 己酉，上太廟諡冊。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: posthumous registers were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou imperial temple posthumous registers were enshrined.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，享六室。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: he offered to the six chambers.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he sacrificed to the six ancestral chambers.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，謝天地於南郊，大赦，禦天安殿受冊號。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: he thanked Heaven and Earth at the southern suburb, proclaimed a great amnesty, and at the Hall of Heavenly Peace received his honorific title.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he thanked Heaven and Earth at the southern altar, amnestied the realm, and took his honorific at the Hall of Heavenly Peace.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，宰相讀天書于天安殿，遂幸玉清昭應宮，作《欽承寶訓述》示群臣。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the chief ministers read the Celestial Text in the Hall of Heavenly Peace, then visited the Jade Pure Palace of Manifest Response and composed Receiving the Precious Instruction to show the officials.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the cabinet read the Celestial Text in the Hall of Heavenly Peace, then at the Jade Pure Palace issued Receiving the Precious Instruction for the court.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔以四月旦日為天祥節。

translations.literal: Day renxu, edict: the first day of the fourth month was made the Tianxiang Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the first of the fourth month became the Tianxiang festival.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，命王旦為兗州太極觀奉上冊寶使。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Wang Dan was made commissioner to present the register and treasure at the Grand Ultimate Abbey of Yan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Wang Dan was sent to Yanzhou’s Grand Ultimate Abbey with the register and treasure.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午，詔振災，發州郡常平倉。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengwu, edict: disaster relief was to draw on each prefecture’s Ever-Normal granary.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, gengwu: disaster relief would tap local Ever-Normal granaries.

sentences.zh: 壬申，禦正陽門觀酺。

translations.literal: Day renshen: he viewed the feast at the Gate of Correct Yang.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he watched the revels at the Gate of Correct Yang.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，置諫官、御史各六員，每月一員奏事，有急務聽非時入對。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: remonstrators and censors were set at six each; one per month would memorialize, and urgent matters might enter audience out of schedule.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou six remonstrators and six censors were named—one memorial a month each, with emergency access allowed.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，王旦加太保、中書侍郎、平章事，向敏中加吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Wang Dan was made Grand Guardian, vice director of the Secretariat, and chief councilor; Xiang Minzhong was made Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Wang Dan became Grand Guardian and chief councilor; Xiang Minzhong took the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 楚王元佐領雍州牧；

translations.literal: Prince of Chu Yuanzuo was made governor of Yong prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Chu Yuanzuo became Yongzhou governor;

sentences.zh: 相王元偓加尚書令兼中書令，進封徐王；

translations.literal: Prince of Xiang Yuanwei was made Director of the Imperial Clan concurrent chief councilor and advanced to Prince of Xu;
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Xiang Yuanwei became clan director and chief councilor and was raised to Prince of Xu;

sentences.zh: 彭王元儼加太保；

translations.literal: Prince of Peng Yuanyan was made Grand Guardian;
translations.idiomatic: Yuanyan, Prince of Peng, was elevated to Grand Guardian;

sentences.zh: 壽春郡王禎兼中書令。

translations.literal: Prince of Shouchun Zhen was made concurrent chief councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Shouchun Zhen became concurrent chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 王欽若加右僕射，趙德明加太傅，中外官並加恩。

translations.literal: Wang Qinruo was made Right Vice Director; Zhao Deming was made Grand Tutor; civil and military officials all received grace.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Qinruo became Right Vice Director; Zhao Deming Grand Tutor; the whole bureaucracy was rewarded.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，考課京朝官改秩及考者。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: capital officials were examined for promotion and for those due review.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi capital officials faced promotion and performance reviews.

sentences.zh: 壬午，定宗室子授官之制。

translations.literal: Day renwu: regulations were fixed for appointing imperial clan sons.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu rules were set for clan appointments.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，進封李公蘊為南平王。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Li Gongyun was advanced to Prince of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Li Gongyun was made Prince of Nanping.

sentences.zh: 秦州神武軍破宗歌族、馬波叱臘等於野吳穀，多獲人馬。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the Divine Martial Army of Qin prefecture defeated the Zongge tribe and Mabochila and others in Wild Wu Valley, capturing many men and horses.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Qinzhou’s Divine Martial Army routed the Zongge and Mabochila in Wild Wu Valley and took many captives.

sentences.zh: 己亥，陳彭年卒。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Chen Pengnian died.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Chen Pengnian died.

sentences.zh: 三月辛丑，以不雨，禱于四海。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinchou: because rain had not fallen, sacrifice was made to the four seas.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, xinchou: with drought persisting, he prayed at the four seas.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，不雨，罷上巳宴。

translations.literal: Day renyin: because rain had not fallen, the Upper Si feast was canceled.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the Upper Si banquet was canceled for drought.

sentences.zh: 庚申，免潮州逋鹽三百七十萬有奇。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: more than 3.7 million in overdue salt tax from Chaozhou was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Chaozhou’s 3.7 million in back salt tax was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，令作淖糜濟懷、衛流民。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: gruel was to be cooked to feed refugees in Huai and Wei circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou thin gruel kitchens were ordered for Huai and Wei refugees.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚辰，陳堯叟卒。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengchen: Chen Yaosou died.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, gengchen: Chen Yaosou died.

sentences.zh: 戊子，邵州野竹生實，以食饑。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: wild bamboo in Shao prefecture bore fruit, which was used to feed the hungry.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi wild bamboo fruit in Shaozhou fed the starving.

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌，詔所在安恤流民。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuxu, edict: each locality was to comfort refugees.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, wuxu: every circuit was told to care for displaced people.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以王旦為太尉、侍中，五日一入中書，旦懇辭不拜。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Wang Dan was made Grand Marshal and Palace Attendant, entering the Secretariat every five days; Dan earnestly declined and was not invested.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Wang Dan was offered Grand Marshal and Palace Attendant with Secretariat duty every five days; he refused the seal.

sentences.zh: 己酉，熒惑犯太微。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Mars crossed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，縱歲獻鷹犬。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the annual tribute of hawks and hunting dogs was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the yearly tribute of hawks and hounds was ended.

sentences.zh: 己未，奉太祖聖容于西京應天院，向敏中為禮儀使。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Taizu’s sacred image was installed at the Hall of Response to Heaven in the Western Capital; Xiang Minzhong was ritual commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Taizu’s portrait was enshrined at Xijing’s Hall of Response to Heaven under Xiang Minzhong’s rites.

sentences.zh: 諸路蝗食苗，詔遣內臣分捕，仍命使安撫。

translations.literal: Locusts ate seedlings on all circuits; edict ordered inner attendants to capture them by circuit and also sent envoys to pacify.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts stripped the provinces; eunuch catchers and relief envoys were sent circuit by circuit.

sentences.zh: 六月壬申，赦西京系囚，死罪減一等，流以下釋之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renshen: Western Capital prisoners were amnestied; capital crimes reduced one degree, exile and below released.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renshen: Xijing prisoners were pardoned—death sentences cut one grade, lesser terms freed.

sentences.zh: 父老年八十者賜茶帛，除其課役。

translations.literal: Fathers and elders eighty years old were given tea and silk and exempted from labor and tax.
translations.idiomatic: Men over eighty received tea, cloth, and tax and corvée relief.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，除升州後湖租錢五十余萬，聽民溉田。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: more than five hundred thousand in rear-lake rent at Sheng prefecture was remitted so the people might irrigate fields.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Shengzhou’s rear-lake rent—over five hundred thousand—was canceled for irrigation.

sentences.zh: 陝西、江、淮南蝗，並言自死。

translations.literal: In Shaanxi and on the Jiang and Huai, locusts were reported to have died on their own.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi, Jiangnan, and Huai reported locust die-offs without human effort.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，盜發後漢高祖陵，論如律，並劾守土官吏，遣內侍王克讓以禮治葬，知制誥劉筠祭告。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: the tomb of Later Han’s Founding Emperor was robbed; punishment followed the law, frontier officials were impeached, inner attendant Wang Kerang was sent to bury with ritual, and drafting academician Liu Yun made offering.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen looters hit Gaozu of Later Han’s tomb; the robbers were sentenced, local officers blamed, and Wang Kerang and Liu Yun restored the rites.

sentences.zh: 因詔州縣申前代帝王陵寢樵采之禁。

translations.literal: Thereupon edict ordered prefectures and counties to report former dynasties’ imperial tombs and forbid woodcutting.
translations.idiomatic: He then ordered every county to list ancient imperial tombs and forbid logging on them.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，免大食國蕃客稅之半。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: half the guest tax on Great Qarakhan envoys was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Great Qarakhan merchants paid half the usual guest tax.

sentences.zh: 龜茲國使張復延等貢玉勒鞍馬，令給其直。

translations.literal: Kucha envoys Zhang Fuyan and others presented jade bridles and saddled horses; they were paid fair value.
translations.idiomatic: Kucha’s Zhang Fuyan and fellow envoys brought jade tack; the court paid market price.

sentences.zh: 己丑，王旦對於崇政殿。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Wang Dan was received in audience at the Hall of Promoting Governance.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Wang Dan faced the emperor in the Hall of Promoting Governance.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁未，霖雨，放朝。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingwei: prolonged rain; court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, dingwei: endless rain closed court.

sentences.zh: 己未，幸魏鹹信第視疾。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: he visited Wei Xianxin’s residence to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he called on the ailing Wei Xianxin.

sentences.zh: 甲子，魏鹹信卒。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Wei Xianxin died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Wei Xianxin died.

sentences.zh: 八月庚午，以王欽若為左僕射兼中書侍郎、平章事。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengwu: Wang Qinruo was made Left Vice Director concurrent vice director of the Secretariat and chief councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, gengwu: Wang Qinruo became Left Vice Director and chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 壬申，向敏中加右僕射兼門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Xiang Minzhong was made Right Vice Director concurrent vice director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Xiang Minzhong became Right Vice Director and Chancellery vice director.

sentences.zh: 王旦對於便殿。

translations.literal: Wang Dan was received in audience at the Convenience Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Dan met the emperor in the Convenience Hall.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔京城禁圍草地聽民耕牧。

translations.literal: Day bingzi, edict: within the capital’s forbidden pasture grounds the people might farm and herd.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi commoners were allowed to plow and graze inside the capital’s imperial pastures.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，禁采狨。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: collecting tree-monkeys was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the tree-monkey hunt was banned.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，免牛稅一年。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: the cattle tax was remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the cattle tax was waived for a year.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛未，詔閣門自今審官、三班院、流內銓，後殿日引公事，勿過兩司。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinwei, edict: from now the Gate Office was to present Review Bureau, Three-Rank Court, and Flowing Within Board business on rear-hall days, not exceeding two offices.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, xinwei: the Gate Office was capped at two bureaus’ business on rear-hall audience days.

sentences.zh: 壬申，諭諸州非時災沴不以聞者論罪。

translations.literal: Day renshen, edict: prefectures that failed to report sudden disasters would be punished.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen officials were warned: hide a local disaster and face charges.

sentences.zh: 己卯，罷京東上貢物。

translations.literal: Day jimao: tribute goods from eastern Jing were ended.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the eastern Jing tribute levy was abolished.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，賜壽春郡王及王友張士遜等詩。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: poems were granted to the Prince of Shouchun and his tutors Zhang Shirun and others.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the Prince of Shouchun and tutor Zhang Shirun received imperial poems.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥，詔曲宴日輟後殿視事。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jihai, edict: on days of informal banquets the rear-hall audience was to be suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jihai: informal banquets would cancel the rear-hall session.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，曹瑋平鬼留家族。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Cao Wei pacified the Guiliu clan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Cao Wei subdued the Guiliu tribe.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔淮、浙、荊湖治放生池，禁漁采。

translations.literal: Day renyin, edict: Huai, Zhe, and Jing-Hu circuits were to maintain life-release ponds and forbid fishing.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Huai, Zhe, and Jing-Hu were ordered to keep mercy ponds and ban fishing.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，幸太一宮，大雪，帝謂宰相曰：「雪固豐稔之兆，第民力未充，慮失播種。

translations.literal: Day yimao: he visited the Grand Unity Palace; heavy snow fell. The emperor said to the chief ministers, “Snow is indeed a sign of abundance, but the people’s strength is not yet full—I fear missed sowing.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao at the Grand Unity Palace a blizzard struck. The emperor told his cabinet, “Snow promises plenty, yet farmers are still weak—I fear they will miss the planting.

sentences.zh: 卿等其務振勸，毋遺地利。

translations.literal: You must urge relief and encouragement and let no acre lie idle.”
translations.idiomatic: Press relief and tillage—waste no field.”

sentences.zh: 」壬戌，契丹使耶律准來賀承天節。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Khitan envoy Yelü Zhun came to congratulate the Ascension Day.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the Khitan envoy Yelü Zhun arrived for Ascension Day.

sentences.zh: 高麗使徐訥率女真首領入對崇政殿，獻方物。

translations.literal: Goryeo envoy Xu Ne led Jurchen chiefs into audience at the Hall of Promoting Governance and presented local goods.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo’s Xu Ne brought Jurchen leaders to the Hall of Promoting Governance with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙寅，京城雪寒，給貧民粥，並瘞死者。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingyin: the capital was cold with snow; porridge was given the poor and the dead were buried.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, bingyin: snow and cold in the capital brought gruel for the poor and burial for the dead.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，罷京城工役。

translations.literal: Day yihai: capital construction was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai capital building projects stopped.

sentences.zh: 丙子，嚴寒，放朝。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: severe cold; court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi bitter cold closed court.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，放逋負，釋系囚。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: overdue payments were forgiven and prisoners released.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou tax arrears were cleared and prisoners freed.

sentences.zh: 己卯，女真國人歸，給裝錢。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Jurchen envoys returning home were given travel money.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao departing Jurchen envoys received travel funds.

sentences.zh: 高麗使徐訥賜射瑞聖園。

translations.literal: Goryeo envoy Xu Ne was granted archery at the Garden of Auspicious Sage.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo’s Xu Ne was invited to shoot at the Garden of Auspicious Sage.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔陝西緣邊鬻穀者勿算。

translations.literal: Day xinmao, edict: along the Shaanxi frontier grain sold to the army would not be taxed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao frontier grain sold to garrisons in Shaanxi went untaxed.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣使緣汴河收瘞流屍。

translations.literal: Day renchen: envoys were sent along the Bian River to collect and bury floating corpses.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen teams scoured the Bian River to bury the drowned.

sentences.zh: 是歲，三佛齊、龜茲國來貢。

translations.literal: That year Srivijaya and Kucha came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Srivijaya and Kucha sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 諸路蝗，民饑。

translations.literal: On all circuits locusts appeared and the people were hungry.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts spread and hunger followed on every circuit.

sentences.zh: 鎮戎軍風雹害稼，詔發廩振之，蠲租賦，貸其種糧。

translations.literal: Wind and hail at Zhenrong army damaged crops; edict ordered granaries opened for relief, rent and tax remitted, and seed grain loaned.
translations.idiomatic: Hail at Zhenrong ruined the harvest; granaries opened, taxes cut, seed loaned.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月乙未，真遊殿芝草生。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month, day yiwei: spirit fungus grew in the Hall of True Wandering.
translations.idiomatic: Year two, spring, yiwei: sacred fungus sprouted in the Hall of True Wandering.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，振河北、京東饑。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Hebei and eastern Jing famine were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Hebei and eastern Jing received famine relief.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，賜壽春郡王《恤民歌》。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the Prince of Shouchun was given the Song Comforting the People.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the Prince of Shouchun received the imperial Song Comforting the People.

sentences.zh: 戊午，王欽若等上《天禧大禮記》四十卷。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Wang Qinruo and others presented forty juan of the Record of the Great Rites of Tianxi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Wang Qinruo submitted forty juan on the Tianxi great rites.

sentences.zh: 己未，遣使諭京東官吏安撫饑民，又命諸路振以淖糜。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: envoys were sent to instruct eastern Jing officials to comfort the hungry; all circuits were also ordered to feed refugees with gruel.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei eastern Jing got famine commissioners and every circuit was told to run gruel kitchens.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅，甘州來貢。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingyin: Gan prefecture came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, bingyin: Ganzhou sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，壽春郡王加太保，進封升王。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the Prince of Shouchun was made Grand Guardian and advanced to Prince of Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the Prince of Shouchun became Grand Guardian and was raised to Prince of Sheng.

sentences.zh: 詔近臣舉常參官堪任御史者。

translations.literal: Edict: close ministers were to recommend regular attendees fit to serve as censors.
translations.idiomatic: Close advisers were told to name regular attendees worthy of the censorate.

sentences.zh: 庚午，右正言劉燁請自今言事許升殿，從之。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Right rectifier Liu Ye requested that from now memorials on affairs be allowed to ascend the hall; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Liu Ye won the right for memorialists to speak before the throne.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，振京西饑。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: western Jing famine was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen western Jing received famine relief.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，幸徐王元偓宮視疾。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: he visited Prince of Xu Yuanwei’s palace to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he called at Prince of Xu Yuanwei’s sickroom.

sentences.zh: 三月辛丑，修京城。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinchou: the capital walls were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, xinchou: the capital fortifications were mended.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，先貸貧民糧種止勿收。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: prior loans of seed grain to the poor were to cease collection.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen seed loans to the poor were forgiven outright.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子，幸飛山雄武教場，宴賜從臣將士。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuzi: he visited the Flying Mountain Martial Training Ground, feasting and rewarding followers, generals, and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, wuzi: at Flying Mountain drill ground he feasted troops and officers.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，赦天下，死罪減一等，流以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: a great amnesty was proclaimed; capital crimes reduced one degree, exile and below released.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the realm was amnestied—death sentences cut one grade, lesser terms freed.

sentences.zh: 閏月，辰州討下溪州蠻，斬首六十餘級，降千餘人。

translations.literal: Intercalary month: Chen prefecture attacked the Lower Xixi barbarians, beheading more than sixty and accepting the surrender of over a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month: Chenzhou crushed Lower Xixi raiders—sixty heads, a thousand surrenders.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔戶部尚書馮拯等舉幕職、令錄堪充京官者各二人。

translations.literal: Day jihai, edict: Minister of Revenue Feng Zheng and others were each to recommend two clerks or county magistrates fit for capital office.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Feng Zheng and peers were each to name two county-level men ready for the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，馬知節為彰德軍留後。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Ma Zhijie was made acting commissioner of Zhangde army.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Ma Zhijie became acting Zhangde commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁未，靈泉出京師，飲者愈疾。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: a numinous spring appeared in the capital; drinkers were cured of illness.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei a sacred spring opened in the capital whose water healed the sick.

sentences.zh: 作祥源觀。

translations.literal: The Abbey of Auspicious Source was built.
translations.idiomatic: Work began on the Abbey of Auspicious Source.

sentences.zh: 壬子，幸徐王元偓宮視疾。

translations.literal: Day renzi: he visited Prince of Xu Yuanwei’s palace to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he again called on the ailing Prince of Xu.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，詔長吏恤孝弟力田者。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renxu, edict: chief magistrates were to care for the filial, fraternal, and diligent farmers.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, renxu: local chiefs were ordered to honor the dutiful and the industrious farmer.

sentences.zh: 甲子，徐王元偓薨。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Prince of Xu Yuanwei died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Prince of Xu Yuanwei died.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，釋下溪州蠻彭儒猛罪。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the Lower Xixi barbarian Peng Rumeng was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Peng Rumeng of Lower Xixi was amnestied.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，西京訛言妖如帽，夜蜚，民甚恐。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: at the Western Capital a rumor spread of demons like hats flying by night, and the people were greatly afraid.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Xijing panicked over night-flying “hat demons.”

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，詔三班使臣經七年者考課遷秩。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renchen, edict: third-rank envoys who had served seven years were to be examined for promotion.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renchen: third-rank envoys with seven years’ service faced promotion review.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔諸州上佐、文學、參軍謫降十年者，聽還鄉。

translations.literal: Day jihai, edict: upper aides, literary officers, and adjutants demoted ten years might return home.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai aides and adjutants ten years in exile could go home.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，訛言帽妖至京師，民夜叫噪達曙，詔捕嘗為邪法人耿概等棄市。

translations.literal: Day yisi: the hat-demon rumor reached the capital; the people shouted through the night until dawn; edict ordered the execution of Geng Kai and others who had once practiced heterodox arts.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi “hat demons” terrorized the capital till dawn; Geng Kai and fellow sorcerers were executed.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，彗出北斗魁。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: a comet appeared at the Dipper’s bowl.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai a comet rose at the Big Dipper’s bowl.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申，以星變赦天下，流以下罪減等，左降官羈管十年以上者放還京師，京朝官丁憂七年未改秩者以聞。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renshen: because of the star’s omen a great amnesty was proclaimed; exile and below had sentences reduced; officials demoted and under restraint ten years or more were returned to the capital; capital officials in mourning seven years without promotion were to be reported.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renshen: the comet brought amnesty—lesser sentences cut, long-banished officials home, mourners overdue for rank reported.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，彗沒。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the comet vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the comet disappeared.

sentences.zh: 八月庚寅，群臣請立皇太子，從之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengyin: the officials requested establishment of a crown prince; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, gengyin: the court’s plea for an heir was granted.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，下溪州彭儒猛納所掠漢生口、器甲等，詔賜袍帶。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Peng Rumeng of Lower Xixi surrendered captives, armor, and goods seized from Han; edict granted robes and belts.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Peng Rumeng returned Han captives and loot and received robes and belt.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，立皇子升王為皇太子。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Prince of Sheng Zhen was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Prince of Sheng Zhen became crown prince.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，宗室加恩，群臣賜勳一轉。

translations.literal: A great amnesty was proclaimed; the imperial clan received grace; all officials were granted one merit turn.
translations.idiomatic: Amnesty followed; the clan was rewarded and every official gained a merit notch.

sentences.zh: 戊申，黎州山后兩林百蠻都王李阿善遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Li Ashan, king of the Two Forests hundred barbarians behind Li prefecture, sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Li Ashan of the Two Forests sent tribute from beyond Lizhou.

sentences.zh: 壬子，彭王元儼進封通王。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Prince of Peng Yuanyan was advanced to Prince of Tong.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Prince of Peng Yuanyan became Prince of Tong.

sentences.zh: 以李迪兼太子賓客。

translations.literal: Li Di was made concurrent crown prince guest.
translations.idiomatic: Li Di joined the crown prince’s staff as guest.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，作《元良箴》賜皇太子。

translations.literal: Day guichou: the Admonition for the Heir was composed and given the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the Admonition for the Heir was written for the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，楚王元佐加興元牧，徐國長公主進封福國，邠國長公主進封建國，宿國長公主進封鄂國。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Prince of Chu Yuanzuo was made Xingyuan governor; Princess of Xu was advanced to Princess of Fu; Princess of Bin to Princess of Jian; Princess of Su to Princess of E.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Prince of Chu took Xingyuan; three princesses were raised to Fu, Jian, and E.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔畎索河水入金水河。

translations.literal: Day yimao, edict: the Yellow River was to be channeled into the Golden Water River.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the Yellow River was diverted into the Golden Water canal.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以德雍、德文、惟政並為諸州防禦使，允成、允升、允甯並為諸州團練使。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Deyong, Dewen, and Weizheng were all made defense commissioners of various prefectures; Yuncheng, Yunsheng, and Yunning were all made training commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Deyong, Dewen, and Weizheng became defense commissioners; Yuncheng, Yunsheng, and Yunning became training commissioners.

sentences.zh: 九月丁卯，冊皇太子。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingmao: the crown prince was invested.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, dingmao: the crown prince was formally enfeoffed.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔全給外戍諸軍物。

translations.literal: Day gengwu, edict: frontier garrisons were to receive full supplies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu border armies were ordered full rations.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，禦乾元門觀酺。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: he viewed the feast at the Gate of Qian Origin.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he watched revels at the Gate of Qian Origin.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚子，禦玉宸殿，召近臣觀刈占城稻，遂宴安福殿。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengzi: at the Hall of Jade Sovereign he summoned close ministers to watch the harvest of Champa rice, then feasted at the Hall of Secure Blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, gengzi: in the Hall of Jade Sovereign he showed Champa rice to intimates, then feasted at Secure Blessing.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛丑，以張旻為武甯軍節度使、同平章事。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinchou: Zhang Min was made military commissioner of Wuning and chief councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, xinchou: Zhang Min became Wuning commissioner and chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 是歲，占城國、甘州、溪峒、黎州山后蠻來貢。

translations.literal: That year Champa, Gan prefecture, stream grottoes, and Li hill barbarians came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Champa, Ganzhou, stream tribes, and Li hill peoples sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 陝西旱，振之。

translations.literal: Shaanxi suffered drought; relief was given.
translations.idiomatic: Drought in Shaanxi brought relief grain.

sentences.zh: 江陰軍蝻，不為災。

translations.literal: Jiangyin army had locust larvae but no disaster resulted.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangyin saw locust larvae but no crop loss.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月癸亥，貢舉人郭待舉等見崇政殿。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, day guihai: tribute graduates Guo Daiju and others were received at the Hall of Promoting Governance.
translations.idiomatic: Year three, spring, guihai: graduates including Guo Daiju met the emperor at the Hall of Promoting Governance.

sentences.zh: 待舉冒喪赴舉，命典謁詰之，即引咎，殿三舉。

translations.literal: Daiju had entered the examination while in mourning; the court usher was ordered to question him; he at once confessed fault and was barred from the hall for three sessions.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Daiju had tested while still in mourning; questioned by the usher, he confessed and was excluded for three rounds.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，河南府地震。

translations.literal: Second month, day yiwei: Henan prefecture suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, yiwei: Henan prefecture shook.

sentences.zh: 三月戊午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuwu new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, wuwu new moon: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 遣呂夷簡體訪陝、亳民訛言。

translations.literal: Lü Yijian was sent to investigate rumors among the people of Shaan and Bo circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yijian was dispatched to trace gossip in Shaan and Bo.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，禦試禮部貢舉人。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: the palace examination of Ministry of Rites tributary graduates was held.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the palace examination tested Ministry of Rites graduates.

sentences.zh: 癸未，翰林學士、工部尚書錢惟演等坐知舉失實，降一官。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Hanlin academician and Minister of Works Qian Weiyan and others were demoted one rank for errors as examination commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Qian Weiyan and fellow examiners lost a rank for faulty grading.

sentences.zh: 甲申，潁州石隕出泉，飲之愈疾。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: a stone fell from a spring in Ying prefecture; drinking it cured illness.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen a stone erupted from a Yingzhou spring whose water healed the sick.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲午，西上閣門使高繼勳坐市馬虧直削官。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiawu: western upper Gate Office envoy Gao Jixun was stripped of rank for buying horses at false prices.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, jiawu: Gao Jixun lost his rank for fraudulent horse purchases.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳，大食國來貢。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingsi: Great Qarakhan came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, dingsi: Great Qarakhan sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，左諫議大夫戚綸坐訕上，貶岳州副使。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Left remonstrator Qi Lun was demoted for mocking the throne to Yuezhou vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Qi Lun, who had mocked the throne, was banished to Yuezhou.

sentences.zh: 辛未，慮囚。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the court reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未，浚淮南漕渠，廢三堰。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guimao: the Huai south transport canal was dredged and three weirs abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, guimao: the Huai south canal was cleared and three sluices removed.

sentences.zh: 甲午，王欽若為太子太保。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Wang Qinruo was made crown prince grand guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Wang Qinruo became crown prince grand guardian.

sentences.zh: 河決滑州。

translations.literal: The Yellow River burst its banks at Hua prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River broke at Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以寇准為中書侍郎兼吏部尚書、平章事，丁謂為吏部尚書、參知政事。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Kou Zhun was made vice director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Personnel, and chief councilor; Ding Wei was made Minister of Personnel and participating administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Kou Zhun became chief councilor and personnel minister; Ding Wei joined the cabinet.

sentences.zh: 滑州決河，泛澶、濮、鄆、齊、徐境，遣使救被溺者，恤其家。

translations.literal: At Hua prefecture the river burst; it flooded Cao, Pu, Yun, Qi, and Xu circuits; envoys were sent to rescue the drowned and comfort their families.
translations.idiomatic: Huazhou’s breach drowned Cao, Pu, Yun, Qi, and Xu; rescue teams aided survivors and kin.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申，曹璨卒。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renshen: Cao Can died.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renshen: Cao Can died.

sentences.zh: 群臣表上尊號曰體元禦極感天尊道應真寶運文德武功上聖欽明仁孝皇帝。

translations.literal: The officials memorialized an honorific title: Emperor of Sagely Substance, Numinous Supremacy, Sensing Heaven, Honoring the Way, Responding to Truth, Precious Destiny, Civil Virtue, Military Achievement, Ascendant Sageliness, Illuminating Benevolence, and Filial Piety.
translations.idiomatic: The court proposed a towering honorific stacking sagely, numinous, heavenly, and filial epithets upon his name.

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dinghai: a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, dinghai: the realm was amnestied.

sentences.zh: 普度道釋童行。

translations.literal: Buddhist and Daoist novices were universally ordained.
translations.idiomatic: Buddhist and Daoist novices were ordained en masse.

sentences.zh: 滑州龍見，河決。

translations.literal: At Hua prefecture a dragon appeared and the river burst.
translations.idiomatic: Huazhou reported a dragon sighting and another river breach.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Venus shone at noon.

sentences.zh: 己亥，慶州亡去熟戶委乞等來歸。

translations.literal: Day jihai: surrendered mature households of Qing prefecture including Weiji and others returned.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Qingzhou’s surrendered tribesmen Weiji and others came back in.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，遣使撫恤京東西、河北水災。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: envoys were sent to comfort the people in eastern and western Jing, Hebei, and flood zones.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu commissioners comforted flood victims in Jing, Hebei, and the east.

sentences.zh: 九月乙丑，慶州骨咩、大門等族歸附。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yichou: the Gumi and Damen tribes of Qing prefecture submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, yichou: Qingzhou’s Gumi and Damen clans submitted.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，遣中官存問高麗貢使之被溺者。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: eunuchs were sent to inquire after Goryeo tribute envoys who had drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi eunuchs were sent to console drowned Goryeo envoys’ families.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月己巳，謁景靈宮。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day jisi: he visited the Hall of Numinous Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jisi: he worshipped at the Hall of Numinous Splendor.

sentences.zh: 庚午，饗太廟。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: he feasted at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he feasted the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 辛未，祀天地於圜丘，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the round altar and proclaimed a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he offered at the round altar to Heaven and Earth and amnestied the realm.

sentences.zh: 選兩任五考無責罰者試身、言、書、判。

translations.literal: Those who had served two terms with five reviews and no penalties were examined in body, speech, writing, and judgment.
translations.idiomatic: Officials with two clean five-year reviews faced tests of body, speech, script, and judgment.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，禦天安殿受尊號冊。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: at the Hall of Heavenly Peace he received the honorific register.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he took the honorific register at the Hall of Heavenly Peace.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，富州蠻酋向光澤表納土，詔卻之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingxu: the Fu prefecture barbarian chief Xiang Guangze offered to submit his land; edict refused.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, bingxu: Xiang Guangze of Fu offered his territory; the court declined.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，向敏中加左僕射、中書侍郎兼禮部尚書、平章事，寇准加右僕射，通王元儼進封涇王，曹利用、丁謂並為樞密使，百官加恩。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Xiang Minzhong was made Left Vice Director, vice director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Rites, and chief councilor; Kou Zhun was made Right Vice Director; Prince of Tong Yuanyan was advanced to Prince of Jing; Cao Liyong and Ding Wei were made military affairs commissioners; all officials received grace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Xiang Minzhong headed the cabinet; Kou Zhun took the right; Yuanyan became Prince of Jing; Cao and Ding joined Military Affairs; the bureaucracy was rewarded.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以任中正、周起並為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Ren Zhongzheng and Zhou Qi were both made deputy military affairs commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Ren Zhongzheng and Zhou Qi became deputy military commissioners.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗、女真來貢。

translations.literal: That year Goryeo and Jurchen came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Goryeo and the Jurchen sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 江、浙及利州路饑，詔振之。

translations.literal: Jiang, Zhe, and Lizhou circuits suffered famine; edict ordered relief.
translations.idiomatic: Famine in Jiang, Zhe, and Lizhou brought relief orders.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月乙丑，以華州觀察使曹瑋為鎮國軍留後、僉樞密院事。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, day yichou: Cao Wei, observation commissioner of Hua, was made acting commissioner of Zhenguo army and attached to the Military Affairs Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Year four, spring, yichou: Hua observer Cao Wei became Zhenguo acting commissioner on the Military Affairs staff.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，開揚州運河。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: the Yangzhou canal was opened.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the Yangzhou canal was dug.

sentences.zh: 己巳，幸元符觀。

translations.literal: Day jisi: he visited the Abbey of Primordial Talisman.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he visited the Abbey of Primordial Talisman.

sentences.zh: 庚午，贈處士魏野著作郎，賜其家粟帛。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: the recluse Wei Ye was posthumously made drafting academician; his household was given grain and silk.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu hermit Wei Ye was posthumously made drafting academician; his family received grain and cloth.

sentences.zh: 二月，帝不豫。

translations.literal: Second month: the emperor was unwell.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: the emperor fell ill.

sentences.zh: 癸未，遣使安撫淮南、江、浙、利州饑民。

translations.literal: Day guimao: envoys were sent to comfort the hungry in Huainan, Jiang, Zhe, and Lizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Huainan, Jiang, Zhe, and Lizhou got famine commissioners.

sentences.zh: 滑州決河塞。

translations.literal: At Hua prefecture the breached river was sealed.
translations.idiomatic: Huazhou’s breach was closed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，發唐、鄧八州常平倉振貧民。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: the Ever-Normal granaries of Tang, Deng, and eight prefectures were opened to relieve the poor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou eight prefectures’ Ever-Normal granaries fed the poor.

sentences.zh: 三月戊午，以淄州民饑，貸牛糧。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuwu: because the people of Zi prefecture were hungry, cattle grain was loaned.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, wuwu: starving Zizhou received cattle-fodder loans.

sentences.zh: 甲子，振蕃部粟。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: tribal grain was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi frontier tribes received grain relief.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔川峽致仕官聽還本貫。

translations.literal: Day gengwu, edict: retired officials of Chuan and Xia might return to their home districts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Sichuan retirees could go home to their native circuits.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，川、廣舉人勿拘定額。

translations.literal: Day guiyou, edict: examination candidates of Chuan and Guang were not bound by fixed quotas.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Sichuan and Guang examinees were freed from rigid quotas.

sentences.zh: 己亥，振益、梓民饑。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the people of Yi and Zi were relieved from famine.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Yi and Zi circuits received famine aid.

sentences.zh: 己卯，向敏中薨。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Xiang Minzhong died.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Xiang Minzhong died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁亥，大風，晝晦。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dinghai: great wind; daylight darkened.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, dinghai: a gale darkened the noon sky.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，分江南轉運使為東、西路。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: the Jiangnan transport commissioner was divided into eastern and western routes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Jiangnan transport was split into east and west offices.

sentences.zh: 丙申，杖殺前定陶縣尉麻士瑤於青州。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: the former Dingtao county sheriff Ma Shiyao was beaten to death with the staff at Qing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen ex-sheriff Ma Shiyao of Dingtao was clubbed to death at Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳，發粟振秦、隴。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingsi: grain was sent to relieve Qin and Long.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, dingsi: grain relief went to Qin and Long.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申，以寇准為太子太傅、萊國公。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingshen: Kou Zhun was made crown prince grand tutor and Duke of Lai.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, bingshen: Kou Zhun became crown prince tutor and Duke of Lai.

sentences.zh: 河決滑州。

translations.literal: The Yellow River burst its banks at Hua prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River broke again at Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，禦試禮部奏名舉人九十三人。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the palace examination of ninety-three Ministry of Rites graduates who had passed the name list was held.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin ninety-three named jinshi faced the palace examination.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁巳，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingsi: Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, dingsi: Venus shone at noon.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，京城大雨，水壞廬舍大半。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: great rain in the capital; water destroyed more than half the houses.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou a cloudburst wrecked more than half the capital’s houses.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以李迪為吏部侍郎兼太子少傅、平章事，馮拯為樞密使、吏部尚書、同平章事。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Li Di was made vice director of the Secretariat, concurrent crown prince junior tutor, and chief councilor; Feng Zheng was made military affairs commissioner, Minister of Personnel, and concurrent chief councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Li Di became chief councilor and crown prince tutor; Feng Zheng joined the cabinet and Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 以霖雨壞營舍，賜諸軍緡錢。

translations.literal: Because prolonged rain ruined barracks, cash was granted to all armies.
translations.idiomatic: Ruined barracks from the rains brought cash grants to every army.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以丁謂為平章事，曹利用同平章事。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Ding Wei was made chief councilor; Cao Liyong was made concurrent chief councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Ding Wei entered the chief councilorship; Cao Liyong joined him.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，入內副都知周懷政伏誅。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Inner Palace deputy director Zhou Huaizheng was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Inner Palace deputy Zhou Huaizheng was put to death.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，太子太傅寇准降授太常卿，翰林學士盛度、樞密直學士王曙並罷職。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: crown prince grand tutor Kou Zhun was demoted to grand director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; Hanlin academician Sheng Du and military affairs academician Wang Shu were both dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Kou Zhun was stripped to Court of Sacrifices director; Sheng Du and Wang Shu left office.

sentences.zh: 八月，永興軍都巡檢使朱能殺中使叛。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Yongxing army patrol inspector Zhu Neng killed an imperial envoy and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: Zhu Neng of Yongxing murdered an imperial envoy and rose in revolt.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以任中正、王曾並參知政事。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Ren Zhongzheng and Wang Zeng were both made participating administrators.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Ren Zhongzheng and Wang Zeng joined the participating council.

sentences.zh: 詔利、夔路置常平倉。

translations.literal: Edict: Ever-Normal granaries were to be established on the Li and Kui circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Ever-Normal granaries were ordered for Li and Kui circuits.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，朱能自殺。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Zhu Neng killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Zhu Neng committed suicide.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，寇准貶道州司馬。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Kou Zhun was demoted to Da prefecture army adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Kou Zhun was banished to Da prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，賜諸軍器幣。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: weapons and goods were granted all armies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen every army received arms and supplies.

sentences.zh: 入內押班鄭志誠坐交朱能，削兩任、配隸房州。

translations.literal: Inner attendant duty officer Zheng Zhicheng was stripped of two ranks and assigned to Fang prefecture for associating with Zhu Neng.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Zhicheng lost two ranks and was sent to Fangzhou for aiding Zhu Neng.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，分遣近臣張知白、晁迥、樂黃目等各舉常參官，諸路轉運及勸農使各舉堪京官、知縣者二人，知制誥、知雜御史、直龍圖閣各舉堪御史者一人。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiyou: close ministers Zhang Zhibai, Chao Jiong, Yue Huangmu, and others were each to recommend regular attendees; each transport and farming commissioner on every circuit was to recommend two men fit for capital office or county magistrate; drafting academicians, supervising censors, and Direct Dragon Diagram academics were each to recommend one fit for censor.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jiyou: a cascade of nomination orders went to intimates, transport officers, and drafting officials for capital and censor posts.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，始禦崇德殿視事，治朱能黨，死、流者數十人。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: he first held audience at the Hall of Promoting Virtue to conduct affairs and tried Zhu Neng’s faction; dozens were executed or exiled.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he reopened the Hall of Promoting Virtue, tried Zhu Neng’s party, and executed or exiled dozens.

sentences.zh: 己未，久雨，放朝。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: prolonged rain; court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei endless rain closed court again.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，給事中朱巽、工部郎中梅詢坐不察朱能奸謫官。

translations.literal: Day renxu: remonstrator Zhu Xun and Ministry of Works director Mei Xun were demoted for failing to detect Zhu Neng’s treachery.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Zhu Xun and Mei Xun were punished for missing Zhu Neng’s plot.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the realm was amnestied.

sentences.zh: 己巳，遣使安撫永興軍。

translations.literal: Day jisi: envoys were sent to comfort Yongxing army.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi commissioners were sent to pacify Yongxing.

sentences.zh: 壬申，賜京城酺。

translations.literal: Day renshen: a capital feast was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the capital was given a public feast.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅，命依唐制，雙日不視事。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuyin, edict: following Tang practice, the throne would not hear affairs on alternate days.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, wuyin: as under Tang, he would skip audiences every other day.

sentences.zh: 壬午，幸正陽門觀酺。

translations.literal: Day renwu: he viewed the feast at the Gate of Correct Yang.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he watched revels at the Gate of Correct Yang.

sentences.zh: 帝自不豫，浸少臨行，至是人情大悅。

translations.literal: Since his illness the emperor had rarely gone abroad; now the people’s hearts were greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: After months of illness his return to the streets lifted the capital’s mood.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以王欽若為資政殿大學士。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Wang Qinruo was made grand academician of the Hall of Assisting Governance.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Wang Qinruo became grand academician of Assisting Governance.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，減水災州縣秋租。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: autumn rent was reduced in flood-hit prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen flood districts got a cut in autumn rent.

sentences.zh: 丙午，召皇子、宗室、近臣玉宸殿觀稻，賜宴。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: princes, the imperial clan, and close ministers were summoned to the Hall of Jade Sovereign to view rice and were feasted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the clan viewed the rice crop at the Hall of Jade Sovereign and feasted.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午，召近臣于龍圖閣觀禦制文詞，帝曰：「朕聽覽之暇，以翰墨自娛，雖不足垂范，亦平生游心於此。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuwu: close ministers were summoned to the Dragon Diagram Pavilion to view imperial literary compositions. The emperor said, “In moments free from listening to affairs I divert myself with brush and ink; though it is not enough to be a model, all my life I have delighted in this.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, wuwu: intimates viewed his writings at the Dragon Diagram Pavilion. The emperor said, “When I am not at statecraft I take up the brush; it will not edify ages, yet it has been my lifelong pleasure.

sentences.zh: 」宰臣丁謂請鏤板宣佈。

translations.literal: ” Chief minister Ding Wei requested that blocks be carved to publish them.
translations.idiomatic: ” Ding Wei asked to carve them for publication.

sentences.zh: 庚申，內出禦制七百二十二卷付宰臣。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: seven hundred twenty-two juan of imperial compositions were issued from within and given the chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen seven hundred twenty-two juan of his writings were handed to the cabinet.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，丁謂加門下侍郎兼太子太傅，李迪加中書侍郎兼尚書左丞，依前少傅。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Ding Wei was made vice director of the Chancellery concurrent crown prince grand tutor; Li Di was made vice director of the Secretariat concurrent Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, still junior tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Ding Wei became Chancellery vice director and crown prince tutor; Li Di kept the left secretariat post.

sentences.zh: 迪、謂忿爭於帝前。

translations.literal: Di and Wei quarreled before the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Di and Ding Wei quarreled before the throne.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，罷謂為戶部尚書，迪為戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Wei was dismissed as Minister of Revenue; Di was dismissed as vice minister of revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Ding Wei left the Revenue ministry; Li Di the vice ministry.

sentences.zh: 任中正、王曾、錢惟演並兼太子賓客，張士遜、林特並兼太子詹事，晏殊為太子左庶子。

translations.literal: Ren Zhongzheng, Wang Zeng, and Qian Weiyan were all made concurrent crown prince guests; Zhang Shirun and Lin Te were both made concurrent crown prince stewards; Yan Shu was made crown prince left aide.
translations.idiomatic: Ren, Wang, and Qian joined the crown prince’s staff; Zhang and Lin became stewards; Yan Shu his left aide.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔謂赴中書視事如故。

translations.literal: Day jisi, edict: Wei was to attend the Secretariat for affairs as before.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Ding Wei was told to keep attending the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔自今除軍國大事仍舊親決，余皆委皇太子同宰相、樞密使等參議行之。

translations.literal: Day gengwu, edict: from now on major military and state matters would still be decided personally; the rest were to be referred to the crown prince with the chief ministers and military commissioners for joint deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he reserved war and great policy to himself and sent routine business to the crown prince and cabinet.

sentences.zh: 太子上表陳讓，不允。

translations.literal: The crown prince memorialized declining; it was not allowed.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince’s refusal was denied.

sentences.zh: 以丁謂兼太子少師，馮拯兼少傅，曹利用兼少保。

translations.literal: Ding Wei was made concurrent crown prince junior tutor; Feng Zheng concurrent grand tutor; Cao Liyong concurrent junior guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Wei, Feng Zheng, and Cao Liyong were named to the crown prince’s tutorial staff.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔自今群臣五日于長春殿起居，餘隻日視朝於承明殿。

translations.literal: Day xinwei, edict: from now the officials would attend at the Hall of Enduring Spring every five days; on other days audience would be at the Hall of Accepting Brightness.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei five-day audiences moved to Enduring Spring; other days met at Accepting Brightness.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，丁謂等請作天章閣奉安禦集。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Ding Wei and others requested construction of the Heavenly Writings Pavilion to house the imperial collection.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Ding Wei asked to build the Heavenly Writings Pavilion for the imperial library.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉，皇太子親政，詔內臣傳旨須覆奏。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yiyou: the crown prince took up government; edict ordered inner attendants transmitting edicts to report back for confirmation.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, yiyou: the crown prince began to rule; eunuch edicts now needed written confirmation.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，龜茲、甘州回鶻遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Kucha and Ganzhou Uyghurs sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Kucha and Ganzhou Uyghurs sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 己丑，王欽若加司空。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Wang Qinruo was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Wang Qinruo became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，議事資善堂，命張景宗侍皇太子。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: deliberation at the Hall of Assisting Governance in Affairs; Zhang Jingzong was ordered to attend the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the Assisting Governance hall debated policy; Zhang Jingzong was assigned to the heir.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以王欽若為山南東道節度使、同平章事。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Wang Qinruo was made Shannan East Route military commissioner and chief councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Wang Qinruo became Shannan East commissioner and chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁卯，以唃廝囉為邊患，詔陳堯咨等巡撫。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day dingmao: because Gusiluo was a frontier trouble, Chen Yaozi and others were sent to patrol.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, dingmao: Gusiluo’s raids sent Chen Yaozi and others to the border.

sentences.zh: 庚午，京城穀貴，減直發常平倉。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: grain in the capital was costly; the Ever-Normal granary was opened at reduced price.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu dear grain in the capital brought cheap sales from the Ever-Normal granary.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，帝不豫，力疾禦承明殿，賜手書宰相，諭以輔導儲貳之意。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the emperor was unwell; forcing himself through illness he held audience at the Hall of Accepting Brightness and granted a handwritten note to the chief ministers instructing them on guiding the heir.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, though failing, he met the court at Accepting Brightness and wrote the cabinet on guiding the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 是歲，京西、陝西、江、淮、荊湖諸州稔。

translations.literal: That year western Jing, Shaanxi, Jiang, Huai, and Jing-Hu circuits had good harvests.
translations.idiomatic: That year western Jing, Shaanxi, Jiang, Huai, and Jing-Hu enjoyed full harvests.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月己丑，帝疾愈，出幸啟聖院。

translations.literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, day jichou: the emperor’s illness abated; he went out to the Abbey of Initiating Sage.
translations.idiomatic: Year five, spring, jichou: recovered, he visited the Abbey of Initiating Sage.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔天下死罪降，流以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day guisi, edict: capital crimes throughout the realm were reduced; exile and below were released.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi death sentences empire-wide were commuted and lesser prisoners freed.

sentences.zh: 乙未，遣使撫京東水災。
